jobs.description:
Mission

The Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at the College of Management of Technology at EPFL invites applications for a full-time PhD student position within the EPFL doctoral school program in Management of Technology (EDMT).

We are offering a challenging full-time PhD student position at the Chair of Operations, Economics and Strategy (OES) at EPFL.

The mission of OES is to conduct world-class research and teaching at the intersection of operations, economics, and strategy, with a focus on organizations and their interactions.

At OES, you will have the opportunity to work on the design, analysis, and implementation of innovative models for decision-making, economics, and operations. Research topics may include optimization, decision-making under uncertainty, market design and pricing, operations research, dynamic systems, and strategy-relevant applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Develop and complete an original doctoral dissertation

• Conduct independent research in close interaction with the Chair and, where appropriate, with external or industry partners

• Contribute to teaching activities, including co-supervision of student projects

• Provide limited support for academic and administrative activities of the Chair

Profile

• An excellent Master’s-level degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

• A strong mathematical background, including familiarity with optimization, probability, and the analysis of mathematical models

• A sincere interest in business-related, economic, and operational problems

• Proficiency in English

• Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and team spirit

• Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset

We offer

• Excellent working conditions in an international research environment

• Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project

• Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions

• The opportunity to work on rigorous, practically relevant research at the interface of operations, economics, and strategy

Informations

Your application should include:

• CV

• Motivation letter

• Diplomas

• Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies

To be eligible for a PhD at EPFL, candidates must be admitted to an EPFL doctoral school program. For this position, candidates should also apply to the EPFL EDMT Doctoral School :
https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/

Application deadlines: January 15, 2027 and April 15, 2027. Applications to OES may be reviewed on a rolling basis; formal admission to EDMT requires a complete application by one of these deadlines.

Expected start date: September 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Missione La Cattedra di Operazioni, Economia e Strategia (OES) presso il College of Management of Technology di EPFL invita le domande per una posizione di dottorato di ricerca a tempo pieno all'interno del programma di scuola di dottorato EPFL in Management of Technology (EDMT). Stiamo offrendo una posizione di studio di dottorato a tempo pieno impegnativo presso la Cattedra di Operazioni, Economia e Strategia (OES) presso EPFL. La missione di OES è di condurre la ricerca e l'insegnamento di livello mondiale all'incrocio di operazioni, economia e strategia, con un focus sulle organizzazioni e le loro interazioni. A OES, avrete l'opportunità di lavorare sulla progettazione, l'analisi e l'implementazione di modelli innovativi per il processo decisionale, l'economia e le operazioni. Gli argomenti di ricerca possono includere l'ottimizzazione, il processo decisionale in incertezza, progettazione di mercato e prezzi, ricerca operativa, sistemi dinamici e applicazioni strategiche rilevanti. Principali doveri e responsabilità
• Sviluppare e completare una tesi di dottorato originale
• condurre ricerche indipendenti in stretta interazione con la sedia e, se del caso, con partner esterni o industriali
• Contribuire alle attività didattiche, compresa la co-supervisione dei progetti degli studenti
• Fornire un sostegno limitato alle attività accademiche e amministrative della Cattedra Profilo
• Un eccellente grado di Master in Ingegneria, Matematica Applicata, Ricerca Operativa, Economia, Ingegneria Industriale, Matematica, Scienza Informatica, o un campo quantitativo relativo
• Un forte background matematico, compresa la familiarità con l'ottimizzazione, la probabilità e l'analisi dei modelli matematici
• Un interesse sincero per i problemi di business, economici e operativi
• Proficienza in inglese
• Forte motivazione per la ricerca accademica, il pensiero critico, l'indipendenza, le buone capacità di autogestione e lo spirito di squadra
• L'interesse per una carriera che coinvolge la ricerca e l'insegnamento è un bene Offriamo
• eccellenti condizioni di lavoro in un ambiente di ricerca internazionale
• supervisione individuale e intensiva del progetto PhD
• Sostegno finanziario in conformità alle condizioni di dottorato dell'EPFL
• L'opportunità di lavorare su una ricerca rigorosa e praticamente rilevante nell'interfaccia di operazioni, economia e strategia Informazioni La tua domanda dovrebbe includere:
• CV
• Lettera di motivazione
• Diploma
• Trascrizioni/classi degli studi di Bachelor e Master Per poter beneficiare di un dottorato in EPFL, i candidati devono essere ammessi a un programma di dottorato in EPFL. Per questa posizione, i candidati devono applicare anche alla scuola medica EPFL EDMT : http://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/ Termine per la richiesta: 15 gennaio 2027 e 15 aprile 2027. Le domande a OES possono essere riesaminate su base regolare; l'ammissione formale a EDMT richiede una domanda completa entro una di queste scadenze. Data di inizio prevista: 1 settembre 2027. Una data di inizio alternativa può essere eccezionalmente concordata con un accordo reciproco. Verranno contattati solo i candidati a lista corta.

Mission Der Lehrstuhl für Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft und Strategie (OES) am College of Management of Technology der EPFL lädt Bewerbungen für eine Vollzeit-Doktorandenposition im Rahmen des Doktorandenprogramms der EPFL in Management of Technology (EDMT) ein. Wir bieten eine herausfordernde Vollzeit-Doktorandenposition am Lehrstuhl für Operations, Wirtschaft und Strategie (OES) der EPFL. Die Mission von OES ist es, weltweite Forschung und Lehre an der Schnittstelle von Operationen, Wirtschaft und Strategie zu führen, mit einem Fokus auf Organisationen und ihre Interaktionen. Bei OES haben Sie die Möglichkeit, an der Gestaltung, Analyse und Umsetzung innovativer Modelle für Entscheidungsfindung, Wirtschaft und Betrieb zu arbeiten. Forschungsthemen können Optimierung, Entscheidungsfindung unter Unsicherheit, Marktdesign und Preisgestaltung, Betriebsforschung, dynamische Systeme und strategierelevante Anwendungen umfassen. Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten
• Entwickeln und Vervollständigen einer ursprünglichen Dissertation
• Durchführung unabhängiger Forschungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Lehrstuhl und gegebenenfalls mit externen oder Industriepartnern
• Beitrag zur Lehrtätigkeit, einschließlich der Betreuung von Studentenprojekten
• begrenzte Unterstützung für akademische und administrative Aktivitäten des Lehrstuhls Profil
• Ein ausgezeichneter Master-Level-Abschluss in Engineering, Angewandte Mathematik, Operations Research, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Mathematik, Informatik oder ein verwandten quantitativen Bereich
• Ein starker mathematischer Hintergrund, einschließlich Vertrautheit mit Optimierung, Wahrscheinlichkeit und der Analyse mathematischer Modelle
• Ein aufrichtiges Interesse an geschäftlichen, wirtschaftlichen und betrieblichen Problemen
• Englischkenntnisse
• Starke Motivation für akademische Forschung, kritisches Denken, Unabhängigkeit, gute Selbstverwaltung Fähigkeiten und Teamgeist
• Interesse an einer Karriere in Forschung und Lehre ist ein Vermögen Wir bieten
• Ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem internationalen Forschungsumfeld
• Individuelle und intensive Betreuung Ihres PhD-Projekts
• Finanzielle Unterstützung gemäß den Doktorandenbedingungen der EPFL
• Die Möglichkeit, an strenger, praktisch relevanter Forschung an der Schnittstelle von Betrieben, Wirtschaft und Strategie zu arbeiten Informationen Ã1⁄4ber Ihre Anwendung sollte beinhalten:
• Lebenslauf
• Motivationsschreiben
• Diplome
• Transkripte/Klassen aus Bachelor- und Masterstudien Um bei der EPFL eine Doktorandenausbildung in Anspruch nehmen zu können, müssen die Bewerber in ein Doktorandenprogramm der EPFL aufgenommen werden. Für diese Position sollten die Bewerber auch für die EPFL EDMT-Doktorandenschule gelten : http://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/ Bewerbungsfristen: 15. Januar 2027 und 15. April 2027. Bewerbungen an OES können rollend überprüft werden; die formale Zulassung zum EDMT erfordert eine vollständige Bewerbung um eine dieser Fristen. Voraussichtlicher Starttermin: 1. September 2027. Ein alternativer Starttermin kann in Ausnahmefällen durch gegenseitiges Einverständnis vereinbart werden. Es werden nur Bewerber kontaktiert.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission La Chaire d'exploitation, d'économie et de stratégie (OES) du Collège de gestion de la technologie de l'EPFL invite les candidats à un poste de doctorant à temps plein au sein du programme d'études doctorales de l'EPFL en gestion de la technologie (EDMT). Nous offrons un poste de doctorant à temps plein à la Chaire d'opérations, d'économie et de stratégie (OES) de l'EPFL. La mission de l'OES est de mener des recherches et de l'enseignement de calibre mondial à l'intersection des opérations, de l'économie et de la stratégie, en mettant l'accent sur les organisations et leurs interactions. Chez OES, vous aurez l'occasion de travailler sur la conception, l'analyse et la mise en œuvre de modèles innovants pour la prise de décision, l'économie et les opérations. Les sujets de recherche peuvent inclure l'optimisation, la prise de décisions dans le cadre de l'incertitude, la conception et la tarification du marché, la recherche opérationnelle, les systèmes dynamiques et les applications stratégiques. Principales fonctions et responsabilités
• Élaborer et compléter une thèse de doctorat originale
• Mener des recherches indépendantes en étroite collaboration avec la chaire et, le cas échéant, avec des partenaires extérieurs ou industriels
• Contribuer aux activités d'enseignement, y compris la co-surveillance des projets étudiants
• Apporter un appui limité aux activités universitaires et administratives de la chaire Profil
• Un excellent master en ingénierie, mathématiques appliquées, recherche opérationnelle, économie, génie industriel, mathématiques, informatique, ou un domaine quantitatif connexe
• Un solide contexte mathématique, y compris la familiarité avec l'optimisation, la probabilité et l'analyse des modèles mathématiques
• Un intérêt sincère pour les problèmes commerciaux, économiques et opérationnels
• Compétence en anglais
• Forte motivation pour la recherche académique, la pensée critique, l'indépendance, de bonnes compétences en autogestion et l'esprit d'équipe
• L'intérêt pour une carrière impliquant la recherche et l'enseignement est un atout Nous offrons
• Excellentes conditions de travail dans un environnement de recherche international
• Supervision individuelle et intensive de votre projet de doctorat
• Soutien financier selon les conditions de doctorants de l'EPFL
• La possibilité de travailler sur des recherches rigoureuses et pratiquement pertinentes à l'interface des opérations, de l'économie et de la stratégie Informations Votre demande devrait comprendre:
• CV
• Lettre de motivation
• Diplômes
• Transcriptions/grades des études de baccalauréat et de maîtrise Pour être éligible à un doctorat à l'EPFL, les candidats doivent être admis à un programme d'études doctorales de l'EPFL. Pour ce poste, les candidats doivent également postuler à l'Ecole EPFL EDMT Doctorale : https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/edmt-management-of-technology/edmt-how-to-apply/ Dates limites de présentation des demandes : 15 janvier 2027 et 15 avril 2027. Les demandes à l'OES peuvent être examinées sur une base continue; l'admission officielle à l'EDMT exige une demande complète dans l'un de ces délais. Date de début prévue : 1er septembre 2027. Une autre date de début peut exceptionnellement être convenue d'un commun accord. Seuls les candidats présélectionnés seront contactés.

jobs.description:
Mission

Despite recent technological advances both in the data management and in computer architecture domains, our ability to analyze data still falls behind the unstoppable data collection rates. Data-intensive applications are increasingly more demanding in sophisticated algorithms to store, manage, and interpret data. To meet the challenges, database software needs to communicate efficiently both with the application layer and with the underlying hardware platforms, and deliver seamless computational and data management support. Research in the DIAS lab addresses both aspects of the challenge: we adapt data management technology to computer architecture trends by designing data manipulation techniques that exploit optimally the underlying hardware and I/O devices, and we enable new discoveries in scientific domains through automating physical database design and revolutionizing exploration algorithms in very large data repositories. The DIAS lab pioneers just-in-time query engines which support analytics on raw data, data cleaning and query optimization for heterogeneous distributed data, and hardware/software codesigned engines for demanding applications.

Main duties and responsibilities

•
Work closely with all members of the lab carrying out excellent research

•
Supervise students and collaborate with other postdocs

•
(optional) Contribute to teaching (especially if interested in an academic career)

Profile

•
Highly motivated with proven scientific excellence in the areas of vector query processing, serverless/just-in-time query execution, parallel and distributed data management, and data management systems on emerging hardware

•
Passionate about inventing, building, and publishing quality database systems research

•
A strong publication record and hands-on experience in system development are especially important

We offer

• The DIAS Lab team is renowned for its collaborative and nourishing culture, which supports the lab’s members since their first day in the team and long after their departure

•
Excellent working conditions

•
The contract is fixed for one year initially, renewable up to four years

Informations

Interested parties should send an application through the system including a CV, a research statement, and the names of at least three references. For inquiries regarding the research aspects of the position, contact Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Contract Start Date : 01/01/2026

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type : CDD

Duration: 1-year fixed-term contract, renewable

Reference: 1809

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Nonostante i recenti progressi tecnologici sia nella gestione dei dati che nei domini dell'architettura informatica, la nostra capacità di analizzare i dati ricade ancora dietro i tassi di raccolta dei dati inarrestabili. Le applicazioni ad alta intensità di dati sono sempre più esigenti in algoritmi sofisticati per memorizzare, gestire e interpretare i dati. Per rispondere alle sfide, il software del database deve comunicare in modo efficiente sia con lo strato dell'applicazione che con le piattaforme hardware sottostanti, e fornire un supporto di calcolo e gestione dei dati senza soluzione di continuità. La ricerca nel laboratorio DIAS affronta entrambi gli aspetti della sfida: adattamo la tecnologia di gestione dei dati alle tendenze dell'architettura informatica progettando tecniche di manipolazione dei dati che sfruttano in modo ottimale l'hardware sottostante e i dispositivi I/O, e consentiamo nuove scoperte nei domini scientifici attraverso l'automazione della progettazione del database fisico e la rivoluzione degli algoritmi di esplorazione in repository di dati molto grandi. Il laboratorio DIAS pionieri dei motori di query just-in-time che supportano l'analisi dei dati grezzi, la pulizia dei dati e l'ottimizzazione delle query per i dati distribuiti eterogenei e i motori codesignati hardware/software per applicazioni complesse.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

•
Lavorare a stretto contatto con tutti i membri del laboratorio che effettuano una ricerca eccellente

•
Superviare gli studenti e collaborare con altri postdoc

•
(opzionale) Contribuire all'insegnamento (specialmente se interessati ad una carriera accademica)

Profilo

•
Altamente motivato con comprovata eccellenza scientifica nei settori dell'elaborazione delle query vettoriali, dell'esecuzione delle query serverless/just-in-time, della gestione dei dati paralleli e distribuiti e dei sistemi di gestione dei dati sull'hardware emergente

•
Passione per l'invenzione, la costruzione e la pubblicazione di sistemi di database di qualità

•
Un forte record di pubblicazione e un'esperienza pratica nello sviluppo del sistema sono particolarmente importanti

Offriamo

• Il team DIAS Lab è rinomato per la sua cultura collaborativa e nutriente, che supporta i membri del laboratorio fin dal primo giorno nella squadra e molto tempo dopo la loro partenza

•
Condizioni di lavoro eccellenti

•
Il contratto è fissato per un anno inizialmente, rinnovabile fino a quattro anni

Informazioni

Le parti interessate devono inviare una domanda attraverso il sistema compreso un CV, una dichiarazione di ricerca e i nomi di almeno tre riferimenti. Per domande riguardanti gli aspetti di ricerca della posizione, contattare Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Data di inizio del contratto: 01/01/2026

Tasso di attività: 100.00

Tipo di contratto: CDD

Durata: 1 anno contratto a tempo determinato, rinnovabile

Riferimento: 1809

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission

Trotz neuer technologischer Fortschritte sowohl im Datenmanagement als auch im Bereich der Computerarchitektur fällt unsere Fähigkeit, Daten zu analysieren, noch hinter die unaufhaltsamen Datenerfassungsraten. Datenintensive Anwendungen sind in anspruchsvollen Algorithmen zunehmend anspruchsvoller, um Daten zu speichern, zu verwalten und zu interpretieren. Um den Herausforderungen gerecht zu werden, muss die Datenbanksoftware sowohl mit der Anwendungsschicht als auch mit den zugrunde liegenden Hardwareplattformen effizient kommunizieren und nahtlose Rechen- und Datenmanagement-Unterstützung bereitstellen. Die Forschung im DIAS-Labor befasst sich mit beiden Aspekten der Herausforderung: Wir passen Datenmanagementtechnologie an Computerarchitekturtrends an, indem wir Datenmanipulationstechniken entwerfen, die die zugrunde liegenden Hardware- und I/O-Geräte optimal ausnutzen, und wir ermöglichen neue Entdeckungen in wissenschaftlichen Domänen durch Automatisierung der physikalischen Datenbankgestaltung und revolutionieren Explorationsalgorithmen in sehr großen Datenrepositorien. Das DIAS-Labor Pioniere Just-in-time-Abfrage-Motoren, die Analytik zu Rohdaten, Datenreinigung und Abfrageoptimierung für heterogene verteilte Daten und Hardware/Software-Codesigned-Motoren für anspruchsvolle Anwendungen unterstützen.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

•
Arbeiten Sie eng mit allen Labormitgliedern zusammen, die exzellente Forschung durchführen

•
Betreuen Sie Studenten und arbeiten Sie mit anderen Postdocs zusammen

•
(fakultativ) Beitrag zur Lehre (besonders wenn interessiert an einer akademischen Karriere)

Profil

•
Hochmotiviert mit bewährter wissenschaftlicher Exzellenz in den Bereichen Vektorabfrageverarbeitung, serverlose/just-in-time-Abfrageausführung, paralleles und verteiltes Datenmanagement und Datenmanagement-Systeme auf neu entstehenden Hardware

•
Leidenschaft für die Erfinder-, Bau- und Verlagsforschung von Qualitätsdatenbanksystemen

•
Besonders wichtig ist eine starke Veröffentlichung und praktische Erfahrung in der Systementwicklung

Wir bieten

• Das DIAS Lab-Team ist bekannt für seine kollaborative und nährende Kultur, die die Mitglieder des Labors seit ihrem ersten Tag im Team unterstützt und lange nach ihrer Abreise

•
Hervorragende Arbeitsbedingungen

•
Der Vertrag ist für ein Jahr festgelegt, bis zu vier Jahre verlängert

Informationen Ã1⁄4ber

Die interessierten Parteien sollten eine Bewerbung über das System einschließlich eines Lebenslaufs, einer Forschungserklärung und die Namen von mindestens drei Referenzen senden. Für Untersuchungen zu den Forschungsaspekten der Position wenden Sie sich an Prof. Anastasia Ailamaki .

Vertragsbeginn: 01/01/2026

Aktivitätsrate : 100.00

Vertragsart: CDD

Dauer: 1-jähriger befristeter Vertrag, nachwachsend

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Malgré les progrès technologiques récents tant dans la gestion des données que dans les domaines de l'architecture informatique, notre capacité à analyser les données est toujours en retard sur les taux de collecte de données inarrêtables. Les applications à forte intensité de données sont de plus en plus exigeantes dans les algorithmes sophistiqués pour stocker, gérer et interpréter les données. Pour relever les défis, les logiciels de base de données doivent communiquer efficacement avec la couche d'application et avec les plateformes matérielles sous-jacentes, et fournir un support de calcul et de gestion des données sans faille. La recherche dans le laboratoire DIAS aborde les deux aspects du défi : nous adaptons la technologie de gestion des données aux tendances de l'architecture informatique en concevant des techniques de manipulation des données qui exploitent de manière optimale le matériel sous-jacent et les dispositifs d'E/S, et nous permettons de nouvelles découvertes dans des domaines scientifiques en automatisant la conception de bases de données physiques et en révolutionnant les algorithmes d'exploration dans de très grands dépôts de données. Le laboratoire DIAS lance des moteurs de requête juste à temps qui prennent en charge l'analyse des données brutes, le nettoyage des données et l'optimisation des requêtes pour les données distribuées hétérogènes, et des moteurs de codage matériel/logiciel pour les applications exigeantes.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

•
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec tous les membres du laboratoire effectuant d'excellentes recherches

•
Superviser les étudiants et collaborer avec d'autres postdoctorants

•
(facultatif) Contribuer à l'enseignement (surtout s'il s'intéresse à une carrière universitaire)

Profil

•
Très motivé avec une excellence scientifique prouvée dans les domaines du traitement des requêtes vectorielles, de l'exécution des requêtes sans serveur/juste à temps, de la gestion parallèle et distribuée des données et des systèmes de gestion des données sur le matériel émergent

•
Passionné d'inventer, de construire et de publier des systèmes de base de données de qualité

•

titleByLocale.en: PhD position "Forest treeline management in the Swiss Alps"
titleByLocale.de: PhD-Position "Forest treeline management in the Swiss Alps"
titleByLocale.fr: Poste de doctorat "Gestion forestière dans les Alpes suisses"

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a challenging position as a full-time (100%) PhD Student at EPFL Valais Wallis in Sion.

As a PhD student, you will develop new technology for forest treeline management in the Swiss Alps. You will design artificial intelligence models to map the treeline evolution from high resolution remote sensing data and then expand on those results with ecological predictive models, projecting the treeline trends in the future using climatic and planning scenarios. You will then analyse drivers of change in a land-use and climate change context. You will work hand in hand with forest professionals and animate co-development workshops to define concrete planning objectives, as well as design management tools for practitioners.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Design deep learning-based methodologies for tree line mapping and analyze tree line dynamics in space and time

• Forecast treeline potential evolution using ecological statistical and mechanistic models based on land-use and climate change scenarios

• Organize and run co-creation workshops with relevant stakeholders

• Develop tools for visualization and forest management

• Write publications

• Attend international conferences, both in ecology and remote sensing

• Participate in the educational activities of the ENAC faculty.

Profile

• You have a master’s degree in environmental science and / or computer science

• You have experience with remote sensing, ecological modeling and population ecology

• You are proficient in Python coding and deep learning frameworks

• You are fluent in English

• You are motivated, curious, and willing to work in a highly dynamic team

We offer

• An inter- and transdisciplinary research project

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career in an exciting area of science

• A unique opportunity to learn high-end techniques and approaches

• Excellent educational conditions and competitive remuneration

• A multi-cultural and stimulating scientific environment, in the EPFL-Valais campus in Sion.

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Programs to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. EDCE. Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

To apply, please use the application link on this page. Your application must contain:

• A letter of interest explaining your motivation for the project and skills (max. 2 pages)

• An updated CV

• Contact details of 3 reference persons.

• Scans of your diplomas and grades from all academic institutions of higher education (after and not including high-school) listed in your CV. If you do not yet have your Master’s diploma, please send a certificate issued by your current institution of higher education that confirms your enrolment in a Master’s program).

• Copy of your passport or official identity document.

• (optional) a sample of your published work (if available), Master’s thesis or semester project.

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: CDD

Duration: 1 year (candidacy examination)+ up to 5 years

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Stiamo offrendo una posizione impegnativa come un tempo pieno (100%) PhD Student presso EPFL Valais Wallis a Sion.

Come studente di dottorato, svilupperai una nuova tecnologia per la gestione delle foreste nelle Alpi svizzere. Progetterai modelli di intelligenza artificiale per mappare l'evoluzione della linea degli alberi da dati di telerilevamento ad alta risoluzione e poi espanderai su quei risultati con modelli predittivi ecologici, proiettando le tendenze della linea degli alberi in futuro utilizzando scenari climatici e di pianificazione. Analizzerai poi i driver di cambiamento in un contesto di utilizzo del suolo e cambiamento climatico. Potrai lavorare di pari passo con i professionisti della foresta e animare workshop di co-sviluppo per definire obiettivi di pianificazione concreta, nonché strumenti di gestione del design per i professionisti.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

• Progettare metodologie basate sull'apprendimento approfondito per mappare la linea degli alberi e analizzare le dinamiche della linea degli alberi nello spazio e nel tempo

• Previsione dell'evoluzione potenziale dell'albero utilizzando modelli statistici e meccanici ecologici basati su scenari di utilizzo del suolo e di cambiamento climatico

• Organizzare ed eseguire workshop di co-creazione con gli stakeholder rilevanti

• Sviluppare strumenti per la visualizzazione e la gestione forestale

• Scrivere pubblicazioni

• Partecipare a conferenze internazionali, sia in ecologia che in telerilevamento

• Partecipare alle attività educative della facoltà ENAC.

Profilo

• Hai un master in scienze ambientali e / o informatica

• Hai esperienza con telerilevamento, modellazione ecologica ed ecologia della popolazione

• Sei competente in Python coding e deep learning frameworks

• Sei fluente in inglese

• Siete motivati, curiosi e disposti a lavorare in un team altamente dinamico

Offriamo

• Un progetto di ricerca interdisciplinare e transdisciplinare

• Un'opportunità per sviluppare una carriera scientifica in un'area emozionante della scienza

• Un'opportunità unica per imparare tecniche e approcci di fascia alta

Mission

Wir bieten eine herausfordernde Position als Vollzeit (100%) Doktorand an der EPFL Wallis Wallis in Sion.

Als Doktorandin entwickeln Sie in den Schweizer Alpen neue Technologien für das Waldstrukturmanagement. Sie werden künstliche Intelligenz-Modelle entwerfen, um die Baumlinienentwicklung von hochauflösenden Fernerkundungsdaten abzubilden und diese Ergebnisse mit ökologischen Vorhersagemodellen zu erweitern und die Baumlinientrends in der Zukunft mithilfe von Klima- und Planungssszenarien zu projizieren. Sie werden dann die Treiber des Wandels im Kontext Landnutzung und Klimawandel analysieren. Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit Forstexperten und animate Co-Entwicklung Workshops, um konkrete Planungsziele zu definieren, sowie Design-Management-Tools für Praktiker.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

• Entwerfen Sie tiefe lernbasierte Methoden zur Baumlinien-Mapping und Analyse der Baumliniendynamik in Raum und Zeit

• Prognosen zur möglichen Entwicklung von Baumlinien mithilfe ökologischer statistischer und mechanistischer Modelle auf Basis von Landnutzungs- und Klimawandelszenarien

• Organisieren und Durchführung von Co-Creation Workshops mit relevanten Akteuren

• Werkzeuge für Visualisierung und Waldmanagement entwickeln

• Veröffentlichungen schreiben

• Intensive internationale Konferenzen, sowohl in der Ökologie als auch in der Fernerkundung

• Teilnahme an den Bildungsaktivitäten der ENAC Fakultät.

• Sie haben einen Master in Umweltwissenschaften und / oder Informatik

• Sie haben Erfahrung mit Fernerkundung, ökologischer Modellierung und Bevölkerungsökologie

• Sie sind in Python Codierung und Deep Learning Frameworks proficient

• Sie sind fließend auf Englisch

• Sie sind motiviert, neugierig und bereit, in einem hochdynamischen Team zu arbeiten

En tant que doctorant, vous développerez de nouvelles technologies pour la gestion forestière dans les Alpes suisses. Vous concevrez des modèles d'intelligence artificielle pour cartographier l'évolution de la ligne d'arbres à partir de données de télédétection à haute résolution, puis vous développerez ces résultats avec des modèles de prévision écologiques, en projetant les tendances de la ligne d'arbres à l'avenir en utilisant des scénarios climatiques et de planification. Vous analyserez ensuite les facteurs de changement dans un contexte d'utilisation des terres et de changement climatique. Vous travaillerez main dans la main avec les professionnels de la forêt et animerez des ateliers de co-développement pour définir des objectifs concrets de planification, ainsi que des outils de gestion de conception pour les praticiens.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

• Concevoir des méthodologies fondées sur l'apprentissage profond pour la cartographie des lignes d'arbres et analyser la dynamique des lignes d'arbres dans l'espace et le temps

• Prévision de l'évolution potentielle de la ligne d'arbres à l'aide de modèles écologiques statistiques et mécanistes basés sur des scénarios d'utilisation des sols et de changement climatique

• Organiser et organiser des ateliers de cocréation avec les parties prenantes concernées;

• Développer des outils de visualisation et de gestion forestière

• Rédiger des publications

• Assister à des conférences internationales sur l'écologie et la télédétection

• Participer aux activités éducatives de la faculté ENAC.

Profil

• Vous avez une maîtrise en sciences de l'environnement et / ou en informatique

• Vous avez une expérience en télédétection, en modélisation écologique et en écologie des populations

• Vous maîtrisez le codage Python et les cadres d'apprentissage profond

• Vous parlez couramment l'anglais

• Vous êtes motivé, curieux et prêt à travailler dans une équipe très dynamique

Nous offrons

• Un projet de recherche interdisciplinaire et transdisciplinaire

• Une occasion de développer une carrière scientifique dans un domaine passionnant de la science

• Une occasion unique d'apprendre des techniques et des approches haut de gamme

• Excellentes conditions d'éducation et rémunération compétitive

• Un environnement scientifique multiculturel et stimulant, sur le campus EPFL-Valais de Sion.

Informations

Le processus de sélection comporte plusieurs étapes, et les candidats présélectionnés seront invités à postuler à un programme de doctorat spécifique de l'EPFL pour obtenir un doctorat à l'EPFL, c'est-à-dire à l'EDCE. Veuillez consulter cette page pour plus d'informations sur l'admission.

Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un processus de candidature séparé nécessaire pour être éligible pour compléter votre doctorat à l'EPFL.

Pour postuler, veuillez utiliser le lien sur cette page. Votre demande doit contenir:

• Une lettre d'intérêt expliquant votre motivation pour le projet et les compétences (max. 2 pages)

• Coordonnées de 3 personnes de référence.

• Analyse de vos diplômes et notes de tous les établissements universitaires d'enseignement supérieur (après et sans l'enseignement secondaire) énumérés dans votre CV. Si vous n'avez pas encore votre diplôme de maîtrise, veuillez envoyer un certificat délivré par votre établissement d'enseignement supérieur actuel qui confirme votre inscription à un programme de maîtrise).

• Copie de votre passeport ou document d'identité officiel.

• (facultatif) un échantillon de votre travail publié (si disponible), thèse de maîtrise ou projet de semestre.

Date de début du contrat : 09/01/2026

jobs.description:
Mission

The Materials in Transition (MATR) Lab at the School of ENAC, EPFL, is looking for a self-driven and inquisitive PhD candidate to start between July and September 2026, or upon agreement, in the field of sustainable construction.

The PhD research will focus on the development of design approaches for building elements that can meet functional performance criteria across multiple lifecycles enabling reuse; adaptability; and reduced environmental impact. This will involve the development of novel assessment methods for reuse under changing socio-economic conditions with a particular emphasis on reversible construction and practical methods for separation, reuse, and reconfiguration. Through this work, you will help redefine how building elements are designed, assembled and reused through the development and validation of practical and scalable approaches to multi-lifecycle design. Possible research directions include:

• Design for disassembly and reversible connection types

• Sustainable material technologies for construction

• Digital and/or parametric design methods for lifecycle-oriented design

• Strategies for building element service life extension

• Experimental validation through prototypes and demonstrator builds

The exact focus will be adapted to the candidate’s background and interests.

MATR Lab

The incoming PhD candidate will be part of a growing and dynamic research team at the MATR lab, led by Prof. Rebecca Hartwell, where we seek to:

• Integrate resilience into the design and application of construction materials in response to evolving socio-economic challenges, such as climate change, social equity, occupant health, and strategic independence in material supply-chains.

• Develop comprehensive digital assessment methods to evaluate whole-life material flows and their associated impact across sectors to inform policy and practice.

• Engineer whole-life adaptability at the product-scale through material science and design.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD candidate, you will be expected to:

• Conduct cutting-edge research including experimental design, data collection and analysis, and dissemination;

• Research in collaboration with academic partners and international collaborators;

• Lead and contribute to scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals;

• Present your work at international conferences;

• Contribute to laboratory activities, including co-supervision of MSc students and teaching assistance.

Profile

• Masters’ degree in architecture, civil engineering, building technology, industrial design, material science or related field - Faq's

• Strong interest in emerging, interdisciplinary fields within architecture and material science

• Interest in conceptual design and a practical and hands-on mindset

• Strong analytical background and problem-solving abilities

• Creative and eager to explore and develop new methodological approaches

• Proficient in, or willing to learn, programming languages (e.g. MATLAB, Python, R)

• Experience with one or more of the following is an asset: LCA tools, computational design, structural design, material research, fabrication or prototyping

• Ability to communicate with researchers from different disciplines

• Self-driven with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively

• Fluency in English is essential [French would be an asset]

We offer

• World-class and international research and training environment with access to state-of-the art experimental facilities and a vibrant scientific and entrepreneurial community

•
Fully funded PhD position with competitive renumeration

• Opportunities to attend and present your work at international conferences

• International collaboration and visiting opportunities through an excellent network of collaborations with industrial stakeholders and leading international universities

• Stimulating work environment based at the Smart Living Lab, EPFL Fribourg

Mission Le Laboratoire Matériaux en Transition (MATR) de l'Ecole d'ENAC, EPFL, est à la recherche d'un doctorant autonome et curieux qui débutera entre juillet et septembre 2026, ou sur accord, dans le domaine de la construction durable. La recherche au doctorat sera axée sur l'élaboration d'approches de conception pour les éléments de construction qui peuvent répondre aux critères de performance fonctionnelle sur plusieurs cycles de vie permettant la réutilisation, l'adaptabilité et la réduction de l'impact environnemental. Il s'agira de mettre au point de nouvelles méthodes d'évaluation de la réutilisation dans des conditions socio-économiques changeantes, l'accent étant mis en particulier sur la construction réversible et les méthodes pratiques de séparation, de réutilisation et de reconfiguration. Grâce à ce travail, vous aiderez à redéfinir la façon dont les éléments de construction sont conçus, assemblés et réutilisés grâce au développement et à la validation d'approches pratiques et évolutives pour la conception de cycles de vie multiples. Les orientations possibles de la recherche sont les suivantes :
• Conception pour les types de connexion démontable et réversible
• Technologies durables des matériaux pour la construction
• Méthodes numériques et/ou paramétriques de conception orientées cycle de vie
• Stratégies pour l'extension de la durée de vie des éléments de construction
• Validation expérimentale par prototypes et démonstrateurs L'attention exacte sera adaptée au contexte et aux intérêts du candidat. Laboratoire MATR Le nouveau candidat au doctorat fera partie d'une équipe de recherche dynamique et en croissance au laboratoire MATR, dirigée par le Prof. Rébecca Hartwell, où nous cherchons à:
• Intégrer la résilience dans la conception et l'application des matériaux de construction pour répondre aux défis socio-économiques en évolution, tels que le changement climatique, l'équité sociale, la santé des occupants et l'indépendance stratégique dans les chaînes d'approvisionnement en matériaux.
• Mettre au point des méthodes d'évaluation numérique exhaustives permettant d'évaluer les flux de matières tout au long de la vie et leur impact sur les politiques et les pratiques dans tous les secteurs.

titleByLocale.en: PhD - Engineering a Microfluidic Platform for Next-Generation Live-seq

titleByLocale.fr: Doctorat - Ingénierie à la plateforme microfluidique pour la prochaine génération Live-seq

jobs.description:
About the lab and your mission

Deplancke Laboratory of Systems Biology and Genetics (EPFL)

The Laboratory of Systems Biology and Genetics, led by Prof. Bart Deplancke, is seeking a highly motivated PhD student to contribute to the development of the next-generation Live-seq instrument, an advanced microfluidic platform that integrates droplet microfluidics with fluidic force microscopy (FluidFM) for continuous, high-throughput single-cell biopsy and live-cell transcriptomics.

Live-seq relies on FluidFM to extract minute quantities of cytoplasmic fluid from living cells for downstream high-sensitivity RNA sequencing, enabling non-destructive, spatio-temporal transcriptome profiling of single cells. Your work will help transition Live-seq from a low-throughput, operator-dependent method into a robust, automated, high-throughput technology with transformative applications in biology, medicine, and drug discovery.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Research in close collaboration with industry partners

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student projects

More specifically, within this project, you will:

• Design, assemble, and optimize a microfluidic module that integrates picoliter droplet microfluidics with next-generation MEMS nanofluidic cantilever probes for continuous cytoplasmic sampling using FluidFM.

• Integrate this micro–nanofluidic module with MEMS cantilever probes from the Fantner lab and with the semi-automated FluidFM system, pressure-control units, and automated sample-dispensing stage developed by Cytosurge, creating a seamless operational platform.

• Perform iterative testing, troubleshooting, and refinement to deliver a robust prototype suitable for routine biological experiments.

• Conduct temporal Live-seq validation experiments using an established cell-differentiation model, benchmarking throughput, transcriptome quality, sensitivity, and overall system performance.

• Document results, present findings to collaborators, and contribute to scientific publications.

Profile

• A MSc degree

• Background in bioengineering, mechanical or chemical engineering, biophysics, microfluidics/nanofluidics, or a related discipline.

• Strong motivation to work at the interface of fluidics, instrumentation, system integration, and cutting-edge single-cell biology.

• Prior experience with micro or nanofluidics and pressure-driven flow systems is strongly valued.

• Organized, proactive, and comfortable working both independently and within a collaborative team.

• Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eager to learn, good organizational skills, rigor in experimental work.

• High level of motivation for academic research work.

• Fluency in English is essential [French / German / Italian would be an asset].

We offer

• Excellent working conditions in a multidisciplinary, world-class research environment.

• Direct involvement in the development of a transformative single-cell technology.

• A uniquely collaborative setting spanning the Deplancke lab (pioneers of Live-seq), the Fantner lab (leaders in MEMS probe engineering), and Cytosurge AG (developers of FluidFM).

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to the Doctoral Program in Biotechnology and Bioengineering (EDBB) to qualify for a PhD at EPFL.
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

Your application should contain:

• A motivation Letter

• Your detailed CV

• Contact information

• The names and contact information of 3 references willing to write

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul laboratorio e la vostra missione Deplancke Laboratorio di Sistemi Biologia e Genetica (EPFL) Il Laboratorio di Biologia dei Sistemi e Genetica, guidato dal Prof. Bart Deplancke, sta cercando uno studente di dottorato altamente motivato a contribuire allo sviluppo dello strumento Live-seq di nuova generazione, una piattaforma microfluidica avanzata che integra microfluidici droplet con microscopia di forza fluidica (FluidFM) per la biopsia monocellulare ad alto rendimento e transcriptomics a celle vive. Live-seq si basa su FluidFM per estrarre quantità minime di fluido citoplasmico da cellule viventi per la sequenziazione del RNA ad alta sensibilità a valle, consentendo la profilazione transcriptome non distruttivo, spatio-temporale di singole cellule. Il vostro lavoro aiuterà la transizione Live-seq da un metodo a basso rendimento, dipendente dall'operatore in una tecnologia robusta, automatizzata, ad alto rendimento con applicazioni trasformative in biologia, medicina e scoperta della droga. Principali doveri e responsabilità Come studente di dottorato, ci si aspetta di:
• Avere piena responsabilità per la propria dissertazione
• Ricerca in stretta collaborazione con partner industriali
• Progettazione sperimentale ed esecuzione
• Analizzare e interpretare i risultati sperimentali
• Scrivere articoli scientifici per la pubblicazione in riviste peer-reviewed
• Presente alle conferenze internazionali
• Partecipazione a progetti di istruzione e supervisione degli studenti Più specificamente, all'interno di questo progetto, si:
• Progettare, assemblare e ottimizzare un modulo microfluidico che integra microfluidici droplet picoliter con sonde nanofluidiche MEMS di nuova generazione per campionamento citoplasmico continuo utilizzando FluidFM.
• Integrare questo modulo micro-nanofluidico con sonde MEMS cantilever del laboratorio Fantner e con il sistema FluidFM semi-automatizzato, unità di controllo della pressione e fase automatizzata di distribuzione del campione sviluppato da Cytosurge, creando una piattaforma operativa senza soluzione di continuità.
• Eseguire test iterativi, risoluzione dei problemi e perfezionamento per fornire un prototipo robusto adatto a esperimenti biologici di routine.
• Condurre sperimentazioni di validazione del Live-seq temporali utilizzando un modello di differenziazione cellulare stabilito, il throughput di benchmarking, la qualità del transcriptome, la sensibilità e le prestazioni generali del sistema.
• Risultati dei documenti, risultati presenti ai collaboratori e contributi alle pubblicazioni scientifiche. Profilo
• Un grado MSc
• Sfondo in bioingegneria, ingegneria meccanica o chimica, biofisica, microfluidics/nanofluidics, o una disciplina relativa.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About the lab and your mission Deplancke Laboratory of Systems Biology and Genetics (EPFL) The Laboratory of Systems Biology and Genetics, led by Prof. Bart Deplancke, is seeking a highly motivated PhD student to contribute to the development of the next-generation Live-seq instrument, an advanced microfluidic platform that integrates droplet microfluidics with fluidic force microscopy (FluidFM) for continuous, high-throughput single-cell biopsy and live-cell transcriptomics. Live-seq relies on FluidFM to extract minute quantities of cytoplasmic fluid from living cells for downstream high-sensitivity RNA sequencing, enabling non-destructive, spatio-temporal transcriptome profiling of single cells. Your work will help transition Live-seq from a low-throughput, operator-dependent method into a robust, automated, high-throughput technology with transformative applications in biology, medicine, and drug discovery. Main duties and responsibilities As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:
• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation
• Research in close collaboration with industry partners
• Experiment design and execution
• Analyze and interpret experimental results
• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals
• Present at international conferences
• Participate in education and supervise student projects More specifically, within this project, you will:
• Design, assemble, and optimize a microfluidic module that integrates picoliter droplet microfluidics with next-generation MEMS nanofluidic cantilever probes for continuous cytoplasmic sampling using FluidFM.
• Integrate this micro–nanofluidic module with MEMS cantilever probes from the Fantner lab and with the semi-automated FluidFM system, pressure-control units, and automated sample-dispensing stage developed by Cytosurge, creating a seamless operational platform.
• Perform iterative testing, troubleshooting, and refinement to deliver a robust prototype suitable for routine biological experiments.
• Conduct temporal Live-seq validation experiments using an established cell-differentiation model, benchmarking throughput, transcriptome quality, sensitivity, and overall system performance.
• Document results, present findings to collaborators, and contribute to scientific publications. Profile
• A MSc degree
• Background in bioengineering, mechanical or chemical engineering, biophysics, microfluidics/nanofluidics, or a related discipline.
• Strong motivation to work at the interface of fluidics, instrumentation, system integration, and cutting-edge single-cell biology.
• Prior experience with micro or nanofluidics and pressure-driven flow systems is strongly valued.
• Organized, proactive, and comfortable working both independently and within a collaborative team.
• Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eager to learn, good organizational skills, rigor in experimental work.
• High level of motivation for academic research work.
• Fluency in English is essential [French / German / Italian would be an asset]. We offer
• Excellent working conditions in a multidisciplinary, world-class research environment.
• Direct involvement in the development of a transformative single-cell technology.
• A uniquely collaborative setting spanning the Deplancke lab (pioneers of Live-seq), the Fantner lab (leaders in MEMS probe engineering), and Cytosurge AG (developers of FluidFM). Informations The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to the Doctoral Program in Biotechnology and Bioengineering (EDBB) to qualify for a PhD at EPFL. Please check this page for additional information on admission. Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL. Your application should contain:
• A motivation Letter
• Your detailed CV
• Contact information
• The names and contact information of 3 references willing to write

jobs.description:
Mission

The EPFL Hydraulic Machinery Platform (PTMH ptmh.epfl.ch ) is a centre of scientific excellence in research and development of hydraulic machines, specializing in performance validation, hydrodynamics and cavitation leveraging advanced measurement techniques and state-of-the-art experimental infrastructure.

We are seeking an Operational Director who, under the guidance of the academic leadership, will lead and oversee the operations of PTMH’s experimental infrastructure. Holding responsibility for the operational management of service contracts, the Operational Director leads an engineering team of 8 staff members, ensures operational excellence and customer satisfaction, and implements strategic direction and service innovation by aligning work practices with institutional priorities.

Main Duties

• Line management of the engineering team

• Operational management of testing platforms and resources in alignment with the academic strategy

• Oversight of platform finances: budget monitoring, payment verification, resource follow-up and financial reporting

• Invoicing and financial follow-up

• Review of service contracts and interface with EPFL Legal Department and Technology Transfer Office

• Coordination of building needs and infrastructure requests

Profile

• University degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field

• An MBA (Master of Business Administration) is considered an asset

• At least 10-year experience in hydraulic machinery model testing

• Experience in operational and team management

• Solid organizational skills

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work autonomously

• Fluency in French and English

What we offer

• A dynamic working environment within a multidisciplinary institution of international renown.

• A position with a high level of autonomy.

• Excellent working conditions.

Informations

Starting date : August 1st, 2026

Activity rate : 40%

Contract type : CDI

Reference : 2215

How to apply

Interested applicants should upload the following documents:

• CV

• 1-page Cover letter

• Relevant work certificates

Screening will start immediately and will continue until a suitable candidate is identified.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Dr Elena Vagnoni (elena.vagnoni@epfl.ch).

jobs.description:
Mission

Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)-funded project on human motivation, stress physiology, immersive behavioral testing, and biological phenotyping.

The Laboratory of Behavioral Genetics at EPFL, led by Prof. Carmen Sandi, is seeking an outstanding postdoctoral researcher with a strong technical and quantitative profile to join a SNSF-funded project investigating human motivation and stress responsiveness.

The project will develop and validate individually calibrated behavioral tasks in immersive virtual reality (VR) to quantify effort-based motivation, vigor, persistence, and goal-directed versus habitual control. It will then test how acute stress alters these processes, combining behavioral performance, physiological monitoring, movement-based phenotyping, and advanced statistical and computational analyses.

This position is part of a broader two-position recruitment linked to the same SNSF-funded project. The present call is for the position focused on human experimental implementation, participant recruitment, psychobiological assessment, biological sampling, and translational biomarker integration. A complementary position will focus more specifically on multimodal sensing, experimental systems, physiological and movement data, and advanced behavioral data analysis.

The position is funded for three years. In line with standard EPFL procedures, the contract is issued on a one-year basis and renewable annually, subject to satisfactory progress and institutional regulations.

Project background

Understanding how stress influences motivated behavior requires experimental approaches that combine rigorous behavioral testing with careful assessment of individual differences and biological stress responses. In this project, participants will complete immersive behavioral tasks designed to measure how they choose, initiate action, sustain effort, adapt to changing contingencies, and respond to acute stress.

The study will combine a standardized acute stress manipulation and behavioral assessments in VR, physiological monitoring, and biological sampling. In addition to endocrine measures, we are eventually interested -in the second part of the project implementation- in integrating broader hormonal, metabolic, inflammatory, and mitochondrial-related biomarkers to better characterize individual biological profiles linked to stress responsiveness and motivated behavior.

A central aim is to develop and validate novel motivational tasks for VR and to understand how anxiety-related traits, stress physiology, and biological response profiles shape motivated behavior. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring that the human experimental pipeline is scientifically rigorous, ethically sound, well organized, and suitable for future translational applications.

Main responsibilities

The postdoctoral researcher will lead the human experimental and translational phenotyping arm of the project. Responsibilities will include:

• Coordinating participant recruitment, screening, scheduling, consent, testing, and retention.

• Implementing the human experimental protocol with high fidelity, including acute stress and neutral control sessions, VR-based behavioral tasks, questionnaires, physiological recordings, and biological sampling.

• Developing and maintaining standard operating procedures for participant flow, stress testing, biological sample collection, sample processing, data tracking, and quality control.

• Training and supervising Master’s students, research assistants, or junior lab members involved in recruitment, participant testing, biological sample handling, and data entry.

• Overseeing saliva collection, processing, labeling, storage, and coordination of endocrine assays, particularly cortisol.

• Contributing to the possible extension of the project toward blood-based hormonal, metabolic, inflammatory, or mitochondrial-related biomarkers.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Progetto finanziato dalla Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) sulla motivazione umana, la fisiologia dello stress, la sperimentazione comportamentale immersiva e la fenotipazione biologica.

Il Laboratorio di Genetica Comportamentale dell'EPFL, guidato dal Prof. Carmen Sandi, sta cercando un ricercatore postdoctoral eccezionale con un forte profilo tecnico e quantitativo per aderire a un progetto finanziato dalla SNSF che indaga la motivazione umana e la reattività di stress.

Il progetto si svilupperà e convalidarà i compiti comportamentali calibrati individualmente nella realtà virtuale immersiva (VR) per quantificare la motivazione basata sullo sforzo, il vigore, la persistenza e il controllo versus abituale dell'obiettivo. Verrà quindi testato come lo stress acuto altera questi processi, combinando prestazioni comportamentali, monitoraggio fisiologico, fenotipazione basata sui movimenti e analisi statistiche e computazionali avanzate.

Questa posizione fa parte di un più ampio reclutamento a due posizioni legato allo stesso progetto finanziato da SNSF. Il presente invito è rivolto alla posizione incentrata sull'attuazione sperimentale umana, sul reclutamento dei partecipanti, sulla valutazione psicobiologica, sul campionamento biologico e sull'integrazione dei biomarcatori traduttivi. Una posizione complementare si concentrerà più specificamente sul rilevamento multimodale, sistemi sperimentali, dati fisiologici e di movimento, e l'analisi dei dati comportamentali avanzata.

La posizione è finanziata per tre anni. In linea con le procedure standard dell'EPFL, il contratto viene rilasciato su base annua e rinnovabile annualmente, soggetto a progressi soddisfacenti e regolamenti istituzionali.

Sfondo del progetto

Capire come lo stress influisce sul comportamento motivato richiede approcci sperimentali che combinano test comportamentali rigorosi con una valutazione attenta delle differenze individuali e risposte di stress biologico. In questo progetto, i partecipanti completeranno i compiti comportamentali immersivi progettati per misurare come scelgono, avviare l'azione, sostenere lo sforzo, adattarsi alle mutevoli contingenze e rispondere allo stress acuto.

Lo studio combina una manipolazione standardizzata dello stress acuto e valutazioni comportamentali in VR, monitoraggio fisiologico e campionamento biologico. Oltre a misure endocrine, siamo infine interessati - nella seconda parte del progetto di attuazione - ad integrare biomarcatori più ampi, metabolici, infiammatori e mitocondriali per meglio caratterizzare i singoli profili biologici legati alla reattività dello stress e al comportamento motivato.

Un obiettivo centrale è quello di sviluppare e convalidare nuovi compiti motivazionali per la VR e capire come i tratti legati all'ansia, la fisiologia dello stress e i profili di risposta biologica modellano il comportamento motivato. Il candidato di successo svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire che il pipeline sperimentale umano sia scientificamente rigoroso, eticamente sano, ben organizzato e adatto per future applicazioni di traduzione.

Principali responsabilità

Il ricercatore postdoctoral porterà il braccio fenotipa sperimentale e traduttivo umano del progetto. Le responsabilità includono:

• Coordinamento del reclutamento, screening, pianificazione, consenso, test e ritenzione dei partecipanti.

• Implementare il protocollo sperimentale umano con alta fedeltà, comprese le sessioni di stress acuto e controllo neutro, i compiti comportamentali basati su VR, i questionari, le registrazioni fisiologiche e il campionamento biologico.

• Sviluppare e mantenere procedure operative standard per il flusso dei partecipanti, test di stress, raccolta di campioni biologici, elaborazione dei campioni, monitoraggio dei dati e controllo della qualità.

• Formazione e supervisione degli studenti del Master, degli assistenti di ricerca o dei membri del laboratorio junior coinvolti nel reclutamento, nel test dei partecipanti, nella gestione dei campioni biologici e nell’inserimento dei dati.

• supervisionare la raccolta, la lavorazione, l'etichettatura, lo stoccaggio e il coordinamento delle analisi endocrine, in particolare il cortisolo.

• Contribuire alla possibile estensione del progetto verso i biomarcatori legati all'ormone, al metabolismo, all'infiammatorio o al mitocondriale.

• Garantire un implem di alta qualità

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission

Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF)-gefördertes Projekt über menschliche Motivation, Stressphysiologie, immersive Verhaltenstests und biologische Phänotypisierung.

Das Labor der Verhaltensgenetik der EPFL, geleitet von Prof. Carmen Sandi sucht einen hervorragenden Postdoktoranden mit einem starken technischen und quantitativen Profil, um einem SNSF-geförderten Projekt beizutreten, das menschliche Motivation und Stressreaktion untersucht.

Das Projekt wird individuell kalibrierte Verhaltensaufgaben in der immersiven virtuellen Realität (VR) entwickeln und validieren, um mühebasierte Motivation, Kraft, Ausdauer und zielgerichtete versus Gewohnheitskontrolle zu quantifizieren. Es wird dann prüfen, wie akuter Stress diese Prozesse verändert, die Verhaltensleistung, physiologische Überwachung, bewegungsbasierte Phänotypisierung und fortgeschrittene statistische und rechnerische Analysen kombiniert.

Diese Position ist Teil einer breiteren Zweipositionsrekrutierung, die mit demselben SNSF-geförderten Projekt verbunden ist. Die vorliegende Aufforderung ist für die Position, die sich auf die menschliche experimentelle Umsetzung, die Teilnehmerrekrutierung, die psychobiologische Bewertung, die biologische Probenahme und die Translationsbiomarker-Integration konzentriert. Eine ergänzende Position wird sich insbesondere auf multimodale Erfassung, experimentelle Systeme, physiologische und Bewegungsdaten und fortschrittliche Verhaltensdatenanalyse konzentrieren.

Die Position wird für drei Jahre finanziert. Im Einklang mit den Standard-EPFL-Verfahren wird der Vertrag jährlich auf einer Jahresbasis und jährlich nachwachsend, vorbehaltlich zufriedenstellender Fortschritte und institutioneller Regelungen.

Projekt Hintergrund

Das Verständnis, wie Stress das motivierte Verhalten beeinflusst, erfordert experimentelle Ansätze, die strenge Verhaltensprüfungen mit sorgfältiger Beurteilung einzelner Unterschiede und biologischer Stressreaktionen kombinieren. In diesem Projekt werden die Teilnehmer immersive Verhaltensaufgaben absolvieren, die darauf abzielen, wie sie sich entscheiden, Aktion initiieren, nachhaltig anstrengen, sich an wechselnde Kontingenzen anpassen und auf akuten Stress reagieren.

Die Studie wird eine standardisierte akute Stressmanipulation und Verhaltensbewertungen in VR, physiologische Überwachung und biologische Probenahme kombinieren. Neben endokrinen Maßnahmen sind wir schließlich - im zweiten Teil der Projektumsetzung - daran interessiert, breitere hormonale, metabolische, entzündliche und mitochondriale Biomarker zu integrieren, um individuelle biologische Profile im Zusammenhang mit Stressreaktion und motiviertem Verhalten besser zu charakterisieren.

Ein zentrales Ziel ist es, neue Motivationsaufgaben für VR zu entwickeln und zu validieren und zu verstehen, wie ängstlich bedingte Eigenschaften, Stressphysiologie und biologische Reaktionsprofile das motivierte Verhalten prägen. Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird eine Schlüsselrolle spielen, um sicherzustellen, dass die menschliche experimentelle Pipeline wissenschaftlich streng, ethisch fundiert, gut organisiert und für zukünftige Translationsanwendungen geeignet ist.

Hauptaufgaben

Der Postdoctoralforscher führt den menschlichen experimentellen und Translations-Phenotypingarm des Projekts. Zu den Aufgaben gehören:

• Koordination der Teilnehmerrekrutierung, Screening, Terminierung, Zustimmung, Tests und Retention.

• Durchführung des humanen Versuchsprotokolls mit hoher Treue, einschließlich akuter Stress- und neutraler Kontrollsitzungen, VR-basierten Verhaltensaufgaben, Fragebögen, physiologischen Aufnahmen und biologischen Probenahmen.

• Entwicklung und Aufrechterhaltung von Standard-Betriebsverfahren für Teilnehmerfluss, Stresstests, biologische Probenerhebung, Probenverarbeitung, Datenverfolgung und Qualitätskontrolle.

• Ausbildung und Betreuung von Master-Studierenden, Forschungsassistenten oder Junior-Labor-Mitgliedern, die an Rekrutierung, Teilnehmertests, biologischer Probenhandling und Dateneingabe beteiligt sind.

• Überwachung der Speichelsammlung, Verarbeitung, Kennzeichnung, Lagerung und Koordination endokriner Assays, insbesondere Cortisol.

• Beitrag zur möglichen Erweiterung des Projekts auf blutbasierte hormonale, metabolische, entzündliche oder mitochondriale Biomarker.

• Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen Teilnehmer-Betrachtung implem
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Projet financé par la Fondation nationale suisse des sciences (SNSF) sur la motivation humaine, la physiologie du stress, les tests comportementaux immersifs et le phénotypage biologique.

Le Laboratoire de génétique comportementale de l'EPFL, dirigé par le Prof. Carmen Sandi, cherche une chercheuse postdoctorale exceptionnelle ayant un profil technique et quantitatif solide pour rejoindre un projet financé par la SNSF qui étudie la motivation humaine et la réactivité au stress.

Le projet développera et validera des tâches comportementales étalonnées individuellement dans la réalité virtuelle immersive (VR) afin de quantifier la motivation, la vigueur, la persistance et le contrôle habituel par rapport aux objectifs. Il testera ensuite comment le stress aigu modifie ces processus, combinant performance comportementale, surveillance physiologique, phénotypage basé sur le mouvement, et analyses statistiques et computationnelles avancées.

Ce poste fait partie d'un recrutement à deux postes plus vaste lié au même projet financé par la SNSF. Le présent appel porte sur la mise en œuvre expérimentale humaine, le recrutement des participants, l'évaluation psychobiologique, l'échantillonnage biologique et l'intégration des biomarqueurs translationnels. Une position complémentaire sera plus spécifiquement axée sur la détection multimodale, les systèmes expérimentaux, les données physiologiques et de mouvement, et l'analyse avancée des données comportementales.

Le poste est financé pendant trois ans. Conformément aux procédures standard de l'EPFL, le contrat est délivré sur une base d'un an et renouvelable annuellement, sous réserve de progrès satisfaisants et de réglementations institutionnelles.

Contexte du projet

Comprendre comment le stress influence le comportement motivé nécessite des approches expérimentales qui combinent des tests comportementaux rigoureux avec une évaluation minutieuse des différences individuelles et des réponses au stress biologique. Dans le cadre de ce projet, les participants effectueront des tâches comportementales immersives conçues pour mesurer leur choix, lancer des actions, soutenir l'effort, s'adapter aux imprévus changeants et réagir au stress aigu.

L'étude combinera une manipulation du stress aigu normalisée et des évaluations comportementales dans la RV, la surveillance physiologique et l'échantillonnage biologique. En plus des mesures endocriniennes, nous sommes finalement intéressés - dans la deuxième partie de la mise en œuvre du projet - à intégrer des biomarqueurs hormonaux, métaboliques, inflammatoires et mitochondriaux plus larges pour mieux caractériser les profils biologiques individuels liés à la réactivité au stress et au comportement motivé.

Un objectif central est de développer et de valider de nouvelles tâches de motivation pour le VR et de comprendre comment les traits liés à l'anxiété, la physiologie du stress et les profils de réponse biologique façonnent le comportement motivé. Le candidat retenu jouera un rôle clé en s'assurant que le pipeline expérimental humain est scientifiquement rigoureux, éthiquement sain, bien organisé et adapté aux futures applications de traduction.

Principales responsabilités

Le chercheur postdoctoral dirigera le volet humain expérimental et translationnel du projet. Les responsabilités seront les suivantes :

• Coordonner le recrutement, le dépistage, le calendrier, le consentement, les tests et le maintien en poste des participants.

• Mettre en œuvre le protocole expérimental humain avec une grande fidélité, y compris le stress aigu et les séances de contrôle neutres, les tâches comportementales basées sur la RV, les questionnaires, les enregistrements physiologiques et l'échantillonnage biologique.

• Élaborer et maintenir des procédures opérationnelles normalisées pour le débit des participants, les tests de résistance, la collecte d'échantillons biologiques, le traitement des échantillons, le suivi des données et le contrôle de la qualité.

• Formation et supervision d'étudiants, d'assistants de recherche ou de membres de laboratoires subalternes engagés dans le recrutement, le test des participants, le traitement des échantillons biologiques et la saisie des données.

• Superviser la collecte, le traitement, l'étiquetage, le stockage et la coordination des tests endocriniens, en particulier le cortisol.

• Contribuer à l'extension possible du projet vers les biomarqueurs hormonaux, métaboliques, inflammatoires ou mitochondriaux à base de sang.

• Assurer une mise en œuvre de qualité face aux participants

jobs.description:
Mission

EPFL is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe, ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide and offers an exceptional working environment with very competitive salaries. The LTS2 Lab https://lts2.epfl.ch offers a highly motivating, interdisciplinary scientific environment with many opportunities to interact between different projects and researchers, and has an excellent network of collaborative research projects with applications ranging from biology to neuroscience. The objective of this project is to develop groundbreaking generative AI methodologies for the design of novel materials. This is part of a large ERC Synergy project involving de novo simulations, automated experimental platforms driven by AI models. It offers extraordinary opportunites to collaborate with materials scientists on a quest to set-up a new blueprint for materials discovery, from computational approaches to actual synthesis and characterization.

Profile

We are looking for 2 PhD students who will contribute novel multimodal generative AI architectures, latent diffusion processes, and reinforcement learning approaches. Interestingly, the proposed model will interface with an automated platform performing experimental materials synthesis and incorporate data from experimental characterization and simulations.

We are looking for PhD candidates with a strong analytical background, and an outstanding MSc degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. You should be proficient in or willing to learn generative deep learning – in particular based on latent diffusion, multimodal approaches, statistics and learning theory. We expect the candidate to be self-driven with strong problem-solving abilities and out-of-the-box thinking. You are willing to contribute and understand new AI architectures, implement and test them. More importantly, you are willing to partake in a collective international research endeavour involving researchers from different disciplines. Professional command of English (both written and spoken) is mandatory. To be eligible for these positions you must also apply and be accepted to the doctoral program in Electrical Engineering. Please check https://www.epfl.ch/education/phd/ for additional information. Please note that this is a separate application process.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

Research in close collaboration with academic partners;

Experiment design and execution ;

Analyze and interpret experimental results;

Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals;

Present at international conferences.

Supervise student projects

We offer

4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities;

A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment;

International collaboration and research internships at other institutions in Belgium and France;

Term of employment: 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years.

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

Your application should contain:

• Motivation Letter

• Detailed CV

• Contact information

• At least 2 references willing to write a recommendation letter.

For more information, please contact: pierre.vandergheynst@epfl.ch

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type : PhD Student

Reference : 2048

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a challenging position as a full-time (100%) PhD Student at School of Engineering - STI at EPFL. At the Laboratory for fundamental BioPhotonics - LBP we are developing nonlinear imaging techniques to study, characterize and image water in different configuration.

Introduction

Electrolyte solutions in water are an essential ingredient of many aspects of life and technology: the bodily fluids (blood and cellular fluid are prime examples), but also are the key contents of batteries. The electrolyte in batteries determines the power output, life span and efficient energy storage. Electrolyte solutions are commonly described as homogeneous mixtures in which ions are statistically distributed. However, it is well known from theoretical considerations in the 1930’s that this simple description is incomplete for the relevant concentration range and that the structure of electrolyte solutions is far more complex. Experiments to understand this need to cover time scales ranging from femto- to milliseconds, and length scales from atomistic dimensions to microns, a huge challenge.

The Project at EPFL

We will use various novel home-built technologies based on nonlinear optical scattering and imaging methods to achieve this: second harmonic imaging, angle-resolved-second harmonic scattering, and correlated vibrational spectroscopy, all ultrafast optical methods, supplemented by standard linear spectroscopy and light scattering methods. These methods will be applied to simple 3D electrolytes in water, and 2D electrolyte regions at aqueous interfaces. Linking all datasets will allow to map both short – and long-range interactions and collective effects pertaining to all molecular actors. This allows to solve the puzzle surrounding concentrated electrolyte solutions and how they work, for example in their charge transmitting/storing functions and lead to a better understanding, and ultimately new technology.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Research in close collaboration with industry partners

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student project

This research has many interdisciplinary aspects that demand a highly motivated candidate with strong analytical abilities that can think out of the box. The successful candidate has a background in photonics, physics, chemistry/material science, or electrical engineering, ideally supplemented by hands-on experience in free space optics / microscopy, nonlinear optics or ultrafast spectroscopy. We offer excellent working conditions and a state-of-the-art infrastructure in a highly dynamic and international environment at the forefront of research.

Profile

• A MSc degree

• Good communication skills and willingness to work as part of a team

• Enthusiasm, scientific curiosity, eager to learn, good organizational skills, rigor in experimental work

• High level of motivation for academic research work

• Fluency in English is essential, French / German / Italian would be an asset

We offer

• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career

• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities

• A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment

• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, photonics, materials science, or electrical engineering.
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process ne
