jobs.description:
Mission

The Research Computing Platform provides advanced IT infrastructure and services to support EPFL’s research community. We are looking for a System Engineer to strengthen our team and help design, deliver, and evolve our service portfolio.

If you are passionate about cutting-edge IT infrastructure and motivated by enabling impactful research, we would love to hear from you.
As part of a small and agile team, you will contribute to a diverse range of services, including compute, storage, and AI platforms, while working closely with researchers and IT teams across EPFL.

This role requires a customer-oriented mindset, adaptability, and strong collaboration skills. You will play a key role in improving service delivery and ensuring our solutions meet the evolving needs of the research community.
We welcome applications from both experienced professionals and recent graduates looking to start their careers.

As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage candidates of all genders, backgrounds, and ages to apply.

Main duties and responsibilities

• Contribute to the maintenance, support, and continuous improvement of our service offerings
• Design, implement, and deploy new services aligned with research and institutional needs
• Collaborate with IT support teams and end users, ensuring high-quality communication and service delivery
• Participate in automation, optimization, and modernization of infrastructure and workflows
• Support the reliability, scalability, and security of platform services

Profile

Required soft skills:
• Strong team player with a structured, reliable, and proactive mindset
• Adaptability and agility in a dynamic environment, with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving
• Excellent communication skills and ability to understand user needs and business challenges
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively
• Interest in working in a multicultural and research-driven environment
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken)
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (or equivalent experience)

Required technical skills:
• Experience with container technologies (Docker, Podman, containerd)
• Experience operating container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes)
• Experience deploying applications in cloud-native environments (e.g., Helm, Terraform)
• Strong knowledge of Linux system administration in production (Ubuntu, Red Hat)
• Experience with on-premises infrastructure (servers, networking, storage in datacenter environments)
• Knowledge of core IT services: DNS, DHCP, load balancing (HAProxy), Keepalived, TLS
• Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet)
• Familiarity with DevOps/GitOps practices and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, FluxCD)
• Experience operating open-source-based services
• Proficiency in scripting and programming (Python, Bash, Git)

We count as advantage your possible experience with (optional technical skills):
• Experience with identity and access management systems (Keycloak, Authentik)
• CNCF certifications (e.g., CKA, CKAD)
• Experience with virtualization platforms (OpenStack)
• Knowledge of web development frameworks (Django, JavaScript)
• Experience with storage systems, filesystems, and data archiving
• Familiarity with cluster schedulers (Slurm)

We offer

• A dynamic, collaborative, and multicultural working environment
• The opportunity to contribute to high-impact scientific research
• A competitive salary based on experience and qualifications
• Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
• A hybrid work model (up to 40% remote within Switzerland)

Informations

Contract Start Date : 08/15/2026

Activity Rate Min : 80.00

Activity Rate Max : 100.00

Contract Type: CDI

Reference: 2248

Contact Person: miguel.fontesmedeiros@epfl.ch

Missione La piattaforma Research Computing fornisce infrastrutture e servizi IT avanzati per supportare la comunità di ricerca di EPFL. Stiamo cercando un System Engineer per rafforzare il nostro team e aiutare a progettare, consegnare ed evolvere il nostro portafoglio di servizi. Se siete appassionati di infrastrutture IT all'avanguardia e motivati da consentire una ricerca efficace, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi. Nell'ambito di un team piccolo e agile, contribuirai a una vasta gamma di servizi, tra cui piattaforme di calcolo, storage e AI, lavorando a stretto contatto con ricercatori e team IT in tutta EPFL. Questo ruolo richiede una mentalità orientata al cliente, adattabilità e forti competenze di collaborazione. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel migliorare la consegna dei servizi e garantire le nostre soluzioni soddisfare le esigenze in evoluzione della comunità di ricerca. Accogliamo le applicazioni da professionisti esperti e laureati recenti che cercano di iniziare la loro carriera. Come datore di lavoro pari opportunità, incoraggiamo i candidati di tutti i generi, sfondi e età da applicare. Principali doveri e responsabilità

• Collaborare con team di supporto IT e utenti finali, garantendo una comunicazione di alta qualità e la consegna dei servizi

• Giocatore di squadra forte con una mentalità strutturata, affidabile e proattiva
• Adattibilità e agilità in un ambiente dinamico, con un approccio pragmatico alla risoluzione dei problemi
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e capacità di comprendere le esigenze degli utenti e le sfide aziendali
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e collaborativo
• Interesse a lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale e ricercato
• Fluente in francese e inglese (scritto e parlato)
• Laurea o Master in Informatica (o esperienza equivalente) Competenze tecniche richieste:
• Esperienza con tecnologie per container (Docker, Podman, containerd)
• Esperienza di piattaforme di orchestrazione dei container operativi (Kubernetes)
• Esperienza nella distribuzione di applicazioni in ambienti cloud-native (ad esempio, Helm, Terraform)
• Forte conoscenza dell'amministrazione del sistema Linux in produzione (Ubuntu, Red Hat)
• Esperienza con infrastrutture on-premise (server, networking, storage in ambienti datacenter)
• Conoscenza dei principali servizi IT: DNS, DHCP, bilanciamento del carico (HAProxy), Keepalived, TLS
• Esperienza con strumenti di gestione della configurazione (Ansible, Puppet)
• Familiarità con le pratiche DevOps/GitOps e condutture CI/CD (GitLab CI/CD, FluxCD)
• Esperienza dei servizi basati su risorse aperte
• Proficienza nella scrittura e nella programmazione (Python, Bash, Git) Contiamo il più possibile la vostra esperienza con (abilità tecniche facoltative):
• Esperienza con sistemi di gestione dell'identità e dell'accesso (Keycloak, Authentik)
• Certificazioni CNCF (ad esempio, CKA, CKAD)
• Esperienza con piattaforme di virtualizzazione (OpenStack)
• Conoscenza dei framework di sviluppo web (Django, JavaScript)
• Esperienza con sistemi di archiviazione, filesystem e archiviazione dei dati
• Familiarità con programmatori di cluster (Slurm) Offriamo
• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, collaborativo e multiculturale
• L'opportunità di contribuire alla ricerca scientifica ad alto impatto
• Uno stipendio competitivo basato sull'esperienza e sulle qualifiche
• Opportunità di apprendimento continua e di sviluppo professionale
• Un modello di lavoro ibrido (fino al 40% di distanza in Svizzera) Informazioni Data di inizio del contratto: 08/15/2026 Tasso di attività Min: 80.00 Tasso di attività Max: 100.00 Tipo di contratto: CDI Riferimento: 2248 Persona di contatto: miguel.fontesmedeiros@epfl.ch

The research focus of the M-Lab of Adaptive Intelligence is on merging artificial intelligence & neuroscience. We aim to understand the mechanisms underlying adaptive sensorimotor behavior in intelligence systems, aka “adaptive intelligence”, and develop new machine learning methods that enable us to do so.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to support our research in understanding affordances - part of the Simons Collaboration on Ecological Neuroscience. You will be part of the team led by Professor Mackenzie Mathis, based in Geneva, Switzerland. Additional information about our research can be found at https://www.mackenziemathislab.org/ .

The Federal School of Technology in Lausanne (EPFL) is one of the leading Institutes of Technology in Europe and offers extremely competitive salaries and research infrastructure.

Requirements

• Candidates should minimally have a Bachelor's in Computer Science or related fields; a Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science is preferred.

• Work is onsite at Campus Biotech in Geneva, Switzerland.

• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills and proven record of effective communication, both written and verbal, with scientists is required.

Profile

• 3+ years of experience in Python & Machine Learning related technologies such as PyTorch, JAX, and TensorFlow.

• Familiar with data management systems (e.g., MySQL and/or DataJoint) and CI/CD workflows.

• 2+ years of professional software development experience.

• Experience building and scaling systems both on-premise and the cloud.

• A record of experience working with scientists and other research engineers.

• Independent, creative, and solution oriented.

• Good team spirit.

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment.

• Continuous training opportunities and excellent working conditions.

• Opportunity to work in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students.

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

You are asked to supply:

• A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages), and

• Two relevant GitHub repositories.

And in one PDF:

• CV, and

• Contact details for 3 referees.

For any further information, please contact: mioara.vasile@epfl.ch .

Contract Start Date : As soon as possible and will then be processed as they arrive until the position is filled. The ideal starting date is summer 2026.

Activity Rate : 100%

Contract Type : CDD

Duration : 1 year, renewable

titleByLocale.fr: Postdoc en photoélectrochimie et corrosion

jobs.description:
Mission

The Laboratory for Renewable Energy Sciences and Engineering ( http://lrese.epfl.ch/ ) at École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) has an opening for a postdoctoral position in in the field of modeling of degradation in photoelectrochemical material systems and devices. The project is part of LRESE’s Sinergia project DegPEC – Degradation mechanisms in photoelectrochemical devices. The subproject goal is to characterize material systems and their degradation, to develop and build stable prototypes of photoelectrochemical solar fuel devices, and to closely interact with and support computational activities on the same topic.

Main duties and responsibilities

Profile

The successful applicant will be responsible for implementing, testing, and operating a stable photoelectrochemical device and for testing degradation of PEC material systems. Some of these tests involve operation and working with high flux solar light. We encourage applicants with an experimental background, experience in (photo)electrochemical characterization techniques, corrosion science, and a holistic view on photoelectrochemical processes and devices.

Additionally, background in heat, mass, and charge transfer (especially radiation), fluid flow, semiconductor physics, and chemistry are required for the project. Experience with computational approaches, numerical methods, and programming are beneficial for the application.

Ideal applicants are expected to have completed their doctorate at the start of the appointment. The ability to work within a collaborative environment, good communication and organizational skills, and scientific initiative are paramount. Additionally, we expect a candidate that

• is independent, creative, and solution-oriented

• has excellent written and oral communication skills in English

• has strong motivation to explore new research domains

• has good team spirit and contributes to general laboratory activities

• and contributes to a safe, clean and effective experimental lab

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

•
A brief cover letter (pdf, up to 2 pages).

And in one PDF:

•
A CV with a publication list.

•
A research statement (pdf, up to 3 pages).

•
Contact details for 3 referees.

Contract Start Date : as soon as possible.

Submissions will be considered until April 30, 2025.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

Il Laboratorio per le Scienze e l'Ingegneria Rinnovabili (http://lrese.epfl.ch/ ) presso École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) ha un'apertura per una posizione post-dottorale nel campo della modellazione del degrado nei sistemi e dispositivi di materiale fotoelettrochimico. Il progetto fa parte del progetto Sinergia di LRESE DegPEC – Meccanismi di degradazione nei dispositivi fotoelettrochimici. L'obiettivo del sottoprogetto è quello di caratterizzare i sistemi materiali e la loro degradazione, sviluppare e costruire prototipi stabili di dispositivi fotoelettrochimici a combustibile solare, e di interagire strettamente con e sostenere le attività computazionali sullo stesso argomento.

Principali doveri e responsabilità

Profilo

Il richiedente di successo sarà responsabile per l'attuazione, il collaudo e il funzionamento di un dispositivo fotoelettrochimico stabile e per il degrado di prova dei sistemi materiali PEC. Alcuni di questi test comportano il funzionamento e il lavoro con luce solare ad alto flusso. Incoraggiamo i candidati con un background sperimentale, esperienza in (foto) tecniche di caratterizzazione elettrochimica, scienza della corrosione, e una visione olistica su processi e dispositivi fotoelettrochimici.

Inoltre, lo sfondo in calore, massa e trasferimento di carica (soprattutto radiazioni), flusso fluido, fisica dei semiconduttori e chimica sono necessari per il progetto. L'esperienza con approcci computazionali, metodi numerici e la programmazione sono utili per l'applicazione.

I candidati ideali dovrebbero aver completato il dottorato all'inizio della nomina. La capacità di lavorare in un ambiente collaborativo, una buona comunicazione e competenze organizzative, e l'iniziativa scientifica sono fondamentali. Inoltre, ci aspettiamo un candidato che

• è indipendente, creativo e orientato alla soluzione

• ha eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale in inglese

• ha una forte motivazione per esplorare nuovi domini di ricerca

• ha un buon spirito di squadra e contribuisce alle attività di laboratorio generali

• e contribuisce ad un laboratorio sperimentale sicuro, pulito ed efficace

Offriamo

• Ambiente di lavoro stimolante e internazionale

• Lo stipendio competitivo e le eccellenti condizioni di lavoro: maggiori informazioni sul nostro sito web (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunità di svolgere ricerche all'avanguardia in una delle istituzioni scientifiche più dinamiche d'Europa.

• Opportunità di interagire con esperti di fama internazionale, e con un team forte di ricercatori post-dottorali e studenti di dottorato

Informazioni

Vengono considerate solo le domande presentate tramite la piattaforma online. Ti viene chiesto di fornire:

•
Una breve lettera di presentazione (pdf, fino a 2 pagine).

E in un PDF:

•
Un CV con una lista di pubblicazione.

•
Una dichiarazione di ricerca (pdf, fino a 3 pagine).

•
Contatti per 3 arbitri.

Data di inizio del contratto: il prima possibile.

Le sottomissioni saranno considerate fino al 30 aprile 2025.

Mission

Das Labor für Erneuerbare Energiewissenschaften und -technik (http://lrese.epfl.ch/) der École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) hat eine Öffnung für eine Postdoc-Position im Bereich der Modellierung von Abbau in photoelektrochemischen Materialsystemen und Geräten. Das Projekt ist Teil des Projekts Sinergia von LRESE DegPEC – Abbaumechanismen in photoelektrochemischen Geräten. Ziel des Teilprojekts ist es, Materialsysteme und deren Abbau zu charakterisieren, stabile Prototypen von photoelektrochemischen Solar-Brennstoff-Geräten zu entwickeln und zu bauen und rechnerische Aktivitäten auf dem gleichen Thema eng zu interagieren und zu unterstützen.

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

Profil

Der erfolgreiche Anmelder ist für die Umsetzung, Prüfung und den Betrieb eines stabilen photoelektrochemischen Geräts sowie für die Prüfung des Abbaus von PEC-Materialsystemen verantwortlich. Einige dieser Tests umfassen den Betrieb und die Arbeit mit einem hohen Fluss Sonnenlicht. Wir fördern Bewerber mit experimentellem Hintergrund, Erfahrung in (photo)elektrochemischen Charakterisierungstechniken, Korrosionswissenschaften und einem ganzheitlichen Blick auf photoelektrochemische Prozesse und Geräte.

Zusätzlich sind für das Projekt Hintergrund in Wärme, Masse und Ladungsübertragung (insbesondere Strahlung), Fluidfluss, Halbleiterphysik und Chemie erforderlich. Erfahrungen mit rechnerischen Ansätzen, numerischen Methoden und Programmierung sind für die Anwendung vorteilhaft.

Ideale Bewerber sollen zu Beginn der Bestellung ihre Promotion abgeschlossen haben. Die Fähigkeit, in einem kollaborativen Umfeld zu arbeiten, gute Kommunikation und organisatorische Fähigkeiten und wissenschaftliche Initiative sind von größter Bedeutung. Zusätzlich erwarten wir einen Kandidaten, dass

• unabhängig, kreativ und lösungsorientiert

• hat ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Englisch

• hat starke Motivation, neue Forschungsbereiche zu erkunden

• hat guten Teamgeist und trägt zu allgemeinen Laboraktivitäten bei

• und trägt zu einem sicheren, sauberen und effektiven Versuchslabor bei

Wir bieten

• Ein anregendes und internationales Arbeitsumfeld

• Konkurrenzfähiges Gehalt und ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen – weitere Informationen finden Sie auf unserer Website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Möglichkeit, hochmoderne Forschung in einer der dynamischsten wissenschaftlichen Institutionen Europas durchzuführen.

• Möglichkeit, mit international renommierten Experten zu interagieren und mit einem starken Team von Postdoktoranden und Doktoranden

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Mission

Le Laboratoire des sciences et de l'ingénierie des énergies renouvelables (http://lrese.epfl.ch/ ) de l'École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) a ouvert un poste postdoctoral dans le domaine de la modélisation de la dégradation des systèmes et dispositifs photoélectrochimiques. Le projet s'inscrit dans le cadre du projet LRESE-Sinergia DegPEC – Mécanismes de dégradation dans les dispositifs photoélectrochimiques. L'objectif du sous-projet est de caractériser les systèmes matériels et leur dégradation, de développer et de construire des prototypes stables de dispositifs photoélectrochimiques à combustible solaire, et d'interagir étroitement avec les activités de calcul et de les soutenir sur le même sujet.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités

Profil

Le demandeur retenu sera responsable de la mise en œuvre, de l'essai et de l'exploitation d'un dispositif photoélectrochimique stable et de l'essai de dégradation des systèmes de CEP. Certains de ces essais impliquent le fonctionnement et le travail avec la lumière solaire à flux élevé. Nous encourageons les candidats ayant une expérience expérimentale, une expérience dans les techniques de caractérisation (photo)électrochimique, la science de la corrosion et une vision holistique des processus et des dispositifs photoélectrochimiques.

De plus, le projet exige un fond en matière de transfert de chaleur, de masse et de charge (en particulier de rayonnement), de débit de fluide, de physique des semi-conducteurs et de chimie. L'expérience des approches informatiques, des méthodes numériques et de la programmation est bénéfique pour l'application.

Les candidats idéaux devraient avoir terminé leur doctorat au début de la nomination. La capacité de travailler dans un environnement de collaboration, les bonnes compétences en communication et en organisation, et les initiatives scientifiques sont primordiales. De plus, nous nous attendons à ce qu'un candidat :

• est indépendant, créatif et orienté vers la solution

• possède d'excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais

• a une forte motivation à explorer de nouveaux domaines de recherche

• a un bon esprit d'équipe et contribue aux activités générales de laboratoire

• et contribue à un laboratoire expérimental sûr, propre et efficace

Nous offrons

jobs.description:
Research challenge

The Research Challenge: AI training costs are exploding, largely due to energy and bandwidth inefficiencies in current electrical datacenters.

Our group is developing a novel Optical Circuit Switched (OCS) architecture that drastically reduces power and latency.

We are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher / Research Engineer with a background in Embedded Systems and Low-Level Programming to design the control logic that powers this new hybrid network.

Your code will directly enable the next generation of energy-efficient AI clusters.

Project scope

•
You will bridge the gap between custom optical hardware and standard AI software stacks .

•
Unlike typical high-level networking roles, this project requires "bare-metal" intervention, programming the firmware and drivers that decide how and when data moves.

Role & Profile

You will lead the implementation of the system's data plane, applying embedded design principles to high-performance networking:

• SmartNIC & FPGA Programming: Implement real-time flow steering logic on devices like NVIDIA BlueField, AMD Pensando or similar.

• Driver Development: Develop and optimize Linux kernel modules and userspace drivers (DPDK) to manage flows.

• Hardware/Software Co-Design: Collaborate with optical physicists to translate physical layer constraints into efficient C/C++ control firmware.

• Evaluation: Benchmark the system against standard IP fabrics and publish results in top-tier conferences (SIGCOMM, NSDI, OSDI).

We are looking for a candidate who is comfortable "looking under the hood" of the operating system. You do not need prior experience with optics.

• PhD/Masters in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Linux Systems Programming .

• Experience with Embedded Linux and Kernel drivers.

Bonus Skills (Nice to have):

• Familiarity with Network Interface Cards (NICs) or packet processing (eBPF, XDP).

• Experience bringing up custom hardware boards.

We offer

• A stimulating and international working environment

• Competitive salary and excellent working conditions – more information can be found on our website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunity to perform state-of-the-art research in one of the most dynamic scientific institutions in Europe.

• Opportunity to interact with internationally renowned experts, and with a strong team of postdoctoral researchers and PhD students

Informations

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply:

Your CV, a brief statement of interests, and a link to your code portfolio (GitHub/GitLab)

descriptionByLocale.it:
La sfida della ricerca

La sfida di ricerca: i costi di formazione dell'IA stanno esplodendo, in gran parte a causa di inefficienze di energia e larghezza di banda negli attuali datacenter elettrici.

Il nostro gruppo sta sviluppando una nuova architettura Optical Circuit Switched (OCS) che riduce drasticamente la potenza e la latenza.

Stiamo cercando un Ricercatore Postdoctoral / Ingegnere di Ricerca con un background in Sistemi Embedded e Programmazione Low-Level per progettare la logica di controllo che alimenta questa nuova rete ibrida.

Il vostro codice consentirà direttamente alla prossima generazione di cluster AI efficienti dal punto di vista energetico.

Obiettivo del progetto

•
È possibile colmare il divario tra hardware ottico personalizzato e stack software AI standard .

•
A differenza dei tipici ruoli di networking di alto livello, questo progetto richiede un intervento "bare-metal", la programmazione del firmware e dei driver che decidono come e quando i dati si muovono.

Role & Profilo

Condurrai l'implementazione del piano dati del sistema, applicando principi di progettazione incorporati alla rete ad alte prestazioni:

• Programmazione SmartNIC & FPGA: implementare la logica dello sterzo in tempo reale su dispositivi come NVIDIA BlueField, AMD Pensando o simili.

• Sviluppo driver: sviluppare e ottimizzare i moduli del kernel Linux e i driver userspace (DPDK) per gestire i flussi.

• Hardware/Software Co-Design: collaborare con i fisici ottici per tradurre i vincoli di livello fisico in un efficiente firmware di controllo C/C++.

• Valutazione: Benchmark il sistema contro i tessuti IP standard e pubblicare i risultati in conferenze di alto livello (SIGCOMM, NSDI, OSDI).

Stiamo cercando un candidato che è comodo "guardare sotto il cofano" del sistema operativo. Non hai bisogno di esperienza precedente con l'ottica.

• PhD/Masters in Informatica, Ingegneria Elettrica o campo relativo.

• Forte competenza nella programmazione dei sistemi C/C++ e Linux .

• Esperienza con i driver Embedded Linux e Kernel.

Bonus Competenze (Niente di avere):

• Familiarità con le schede di interfaccia di rete (NIC) o elaborazione dei pacchetti (eBPF, XDP).

• Esperienza che presenta schede hardware personalizzate.

Offriamo

• Ambiente di lavoro stimolante e internazionale

• Lo stipendio competitivo e le eccellenti condizioni di lavoro: maggiori informazioni sul nostro sito web (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Opportunità di svolgere ricerche all'avanguardia in una delle istituzioni scientifiche più dinamiche d'Europa.

• Opportunità di interagire con esperti di fama internazionale, e con un team forte di ricercatori post-dottorali e studenti di dottorato

Informazioni

Vengono considerate solo le domande presentate tramite la piattaforma online. Ti viene chiesto di fornire:

Il tuo CV, una breve dichiarazione di interessi e un link al tuo portafoglio di codici (GitHub/GitLab)

Per ulteriori informazioni, rivolgersi a: mustafa.yildirim@epfl.ch

descriptionByLocale.de:
Herausforderung der Forschung

Die Forschungsherausforderung: KI-Trainingskosten sind explodierend, vor allem aufgrund von Energie- und Bandbreitenineffizienzen in aktuellen elektrischen Rechenzentren.

Unsere Gruppe entwickelt eine neuartige Optical Circuit Switched (OCS) Architektur, die Energie und Latenz drastisch reduziert.

Wir suchen einen Postdoctoral Researcher / Research Engineer mit einem Hintergrund in Embedded Systems und Low-Level Programmierung, um die Steuerungslogik zu entwerfen, die dieses neue Hybrid-Netzwerk antreibt.

Ihr Code ermöglicht direkt die nächste Generation energieeffizienter KI-Cluster.

Projektumfang

•
Sie überbrücken die Lücke zwischen benutzerdefinierten optischen Hardware und Standard-KI-Software-Stacks .

•
Im Gegensatz zu typischen High-Level-Netzwerk-Rollen erfordert dieses Projekt "Big-metal" Intervention, Programmierung der Firmware und Treiber, die entscheiden, wie und wann Daten bewegt.

Rolle und Profil

Sie leiten die Implementierung der Datenebene des Systems, indem Sie eingebettete Designprinzipien auf eine leistungsstarke Vernetzung anwenden:

• SmartNIC & FPGA Programmierung: Implementieren Echtzeit-Flow-Lenklogik auf Geräten wie NVIDIA BlueField, AMD Pensando oder dergleichen.

• Treiberentwicklung: Entwickeln und optimieren Sie Linux-Kernel-Module und Userspace-Treiber (DPDK), um Ströme zu verwalten.

• Hardware/Software Co-Design: Mit optischen Physikern zusammenarbeiten, um physikalische Schichtzwänge in effiziente C/C++-Kontroll-Firmware zu übersetzen.

• Evaluation: Benchmark das System gegen Standard-IP-Gewebe und veröffentlicht Ergebnisse in Top-Tier-Konferenzen (SIGCOMM, NSDI, OSDI).

Wir suchen einen Kandidaten, der sich "unter der Haube" des Betriebssystems wohlfühlt. Sie brauchen keine vorherige Erfahrung mit der Optik.

• PhD/Masters in Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder verwandten Bereich.

• Starke Kenntnisse in C/C++ und Linux Systems Programmierung .

• Erfahrung mit Embedded Linux und Kernel Treibern.

Bonus Skills (Nice to have):

• Vertrautheit mit Netzwerkschnittstellenkarten (NICs) oder Paketverarbeitung (eBPF, XDP).

• Erleben Sie die Erstellung von benutzerdefinierten Hardware-Boards.

Wir bieten

• Ein anregendes und internationales Arbeitsumfeld

• Konkurrenzfähiges Gehalt und ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen – weitere Informationen finden Sie auf unserer Website (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/en/basic-starting-salary-of-doctoral-assistants-and-postdocs/)

• Möglichkeit, hochmoderne Forschung in einer der dynamischsten wissenschaftlichen Institutionen Europas durchzuführen.

• Möglichkeit, mit international renommierten Experten zu interagieren und mit einem starken Team von Postdoktoranden und Doktoranden

Ihr Lebenslauf, eine kurze Interessenerklärung und ein Link zu Ihrem Code-Portfolio (GitHub/GitLab)

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Défi de la recherche

Le défi de la recherche : les coûts de formation à l'IA sont en plein essor, en grande partie en raison de l'inefficacité énergétique et de la bande passante dans les datacenters électriques actuels.

Notre groupe développe une nouvelle architecture de commutation de circuits optiques (OCS) qui réduit considérablement la puissance et la latence.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chercheur postdoctoral / ingénieur de recherche ayant une formation en systèmes embarqués et programmation de bas niveau pour concevoir la logique de contrôle qui alimente ce nouveau réseau hybride.

Votre code permettra directement la prochaine génération de grappes d'IA économes en énergie.

Portée du projet

•
Vous comblerez l'écart entre le matériel optique personnalisé et les piles logicielles standard d'IA.

•
Contrairement aux rôles habituels de réseautage de haut niveau, ce projet nécessite une intervention « braise-métal », la programmation du firmware et des moteurs qui décident comment et quand les données se déplacent.

Rôle et profil

Vous dirigerez la mise en œuvre du plan de données du système, en appliquant les principes de conception embarqués au réseau haute performance:

• Programmation SmartNIC & FPGA: Implémenter la logique de direction en temps réel sur des appareils comme NVIDIA BlueField, AMD Pensando ou similaires.

• Développement des pilotes : Développer et optimiser les modules du noyau Linux et les pilotes d'espace utilisateur (DPDK) pour gérer les flux.

• Co-conception hardware/logiciel: Collaborer avec les physiciens optiques pour traduire les contraintes de couches physiques en firmware de contrôle C/C++ efficace.

• Évaluation: Benchmark le système contre les tissus IP standard et publier les résultats dans les conférences de haut niveau (SIGCOMM, NSDI, OSDI).

Nous recherchons un candidat qui est à l'aise « regarder sous le capot » du système d'exploitation. Vous n'avez pas besoin d'expérience préalable avec l'optique.

• Doctorat/maîtrise en informatique, génie électrique ou domaine connexe.

• Forte compétence en programmation de systèmes C/C++ et Linux.

• Expérience avec les pilotes embarqués Linux et Kernel.

Compétences en bonus (bon à avoir):

• Familiarité avec les cartes d'interface réseau (NIC) ou traitement de paquets (eBPF, XDP).

• Expérimentez l'ajout de cartes matérielles personnalisées.

Nous offrons

• Un environnement de travail stimulant et international

• Salaire compétitif et excellentes conditions de travail – de plus amples informations sont disponibles sur notre site Web (https://www.epfl.ch/campus/services/human-resources/fr/basic-starting-salary-of-doctorants-and-postdocs/)

• Possibilité de réaliser des recherches de pointe dans l'une des institutions scientifiques les plus dynamiques d'Europe.

• Possibilité d'interagir avec des experts de renommée internationale et avec une solide équipe de chercheurs postdoctoraux et d'étudiants au doctorat

Informations

Seules les demandes soumises par le biais de la plateforme en ligne sont prises en considération. On vous demande de fournir:

Votre CV, une brève déclaration d'intérêt et un lien vers votre portefeuille de codes (GitHub/GitLab)

Pour toute information complémentaire, veuillez contacter: mustafa.yildirim@epfl.ch

Taux d'activité: 100%
Type de contrat: CDD
Durée: 9 mois, extensible

jobs.description:
Mission

Rejoignez le Domaine Expérience Employé·es et contribuez activement à la mise en place de sa nouvelle organisation en prenant le rôle de Généraliste PEXP.

Dans cette fonction, vous soutiendrez le ou la Responsable PEXP sur son périmètre ainsi que ponctuellement les Partenaires PEXP sur des dossiers spécifiques.

Vous serez également en charge de diverses activités de gestion opérationnelle du personnel, en garantissant la conformité, la qualité et la cohérence des pratiques.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

- Apporte soutien aux responsables d’unité dans des situations de gestion du personnel

- Collabore avec les différents pôles d’expertises

- Contribue activement à des projets internes et transversaux, à des groupes de travail, à des animations d’ateliers dans le but de développer nos processus et prestations

- Conseille et accompagne les collaborateur·rices tout au long de leur carrière à l’EPFL et répond à leurs questions relatives à la gestion du personnel

- Coordonne les aspects du cycle de vie en partenariat avec les services à disposition

- Apporte soutien dans les processus annuels tel que révision de salaire, gestion de la performance et développement du personnel, etc.

- Prépare des offres salariales pour les nouveaux engagements

- Selon besoin, participe aux processus de recrutements

Profil

- Formation universitaire ou HES, avec une spécialisation en Ressources Humaines, ou formation jugée équivalente
- Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans une fonction analogue avec le même type de responsabilités, au sein d’une grande entreprise ou institution

- Incarner la posture du facilitateur / médiateur

- Maîtrise des techniques d’entretiens
- Excellentes compétences de communication orale et écrite, en français et anglais
- Orientation clients et sens relationnel
- Aisance avec les chiffres, excellente maitrise des outils bureautiques (excel, ppt).

- Approche orientée résultats
- Bienveillance, diplomatie, sens de la confidentialité
- Capacité d’analyse des besoins, de synthèse
- Très bonne organisation et excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs processus en parallèle

Nous offrons

- Un environnement de travail stimulant, dynamique et multiculturel au sein du Domaine Expérience Employé·es de notre Vice-Présidence pour le développement humain ( lien )

- Une équipe qui se construit où chaque membre valorise la collaboration, la fluidité des activités et la bienveillance

- Des conditions de travail attractive favorisant l’équilibre, le développement et l'engagement professionnel.

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : De suite

Taux d'occupation min : 80.00

Taux d'occupation max : 100.00

Type de contrat : CDI

Référence : 2156

jobs.title: Postdoctoral researcher in building technology

titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur postdoctoral en technologie du bâtiment

jobs.description:
Profile

The Structural Xploration Lab is seeking a new research collaborator with a PhD in building technology, preferably in the field of building materials and/or building envelope performance and/or building renovation. The candidate must be familiar with contemporary construction techniques and have an interest in 20th-century construction techniques or vernacular architecture. Experience in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Building Information Modelling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or computer programming is a plus. A master's degree or professional experience in architecture is preferred but not required.

The employment rate varies between 80% and 100%, depending on the candidate's availability. This is a 9-month contract, renewable. The earliest start date is May 1st or as soon as possible.

Missions

The main research activities will be related to the characterization and circular performance assessment of building envelopes in Europe, with a scope ranging from construction details and building archetypes to large-scale inference of building stocks. The project is embedded into a EU-Horizon project in collaboration with foreign industrial and research partners.

The candidate may also contribute to other research and teaching activities as well as to the supervision of architecture students at bachelor's and master's level.

About us

The Structural Xploration Lab is a group of doctoral and postdoctoral researchers in architecture and civil engineering. It is known for its development of tools, design methods, large-scale analyses and built prototypes aimed at enabling the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) sector to adopt more circular load-bearing systems. SXL also contributes to teaching building technologies and circular practices to undergraduate, master's students and professionals in architecture and civil engineering. As a unit of EPFL's ENAC faculty and located in the Smart Living Lab in Fribourg (CH), SXL benefits from state-of-the-art research infrastructure and offers an inclusive, international and stimulating work environment.

Application

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. You are asked to supply your CV and a brief statement of interests.

For any further information, please contact teresa.messina@epfl.ch .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Profilo

Il Laboratorio di Xploration strutturale sta cercando un nuovo collaboratore di ricerca con un PhD nella tecnologia dell'edilizia, preferibilmente nel campo dei materiali da costruzione e/o delle prestazioni della busta da costruzione e/o della ristrutturazione di edifici. Il candidato deve conoscere le tecniche costruttive contemporanee e avere un interesse per le tecniche costruttive del XX secolo o l'architettura vernacolare. Esperienza in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Building Information Modelling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) o programmazione del computer è un plus. Un master o esperienza professionale in architettura è preferito ma non richiesto.

Il tasso di occupazione varia tra l'80% e il 100%, a seconda della disponibilità del candidato. Questo è un contratto di 9 mesi, rinnovabile. La prima data di inizio è il 1 maggio o il più presto possibile.

Missioni

Le principali attività di ricerca saranno connesse alla caratterizzazione e alla valutazione delle prestazioni circolari delle buste edili in Europa, con un ambito che spazia dai dettagli delle costruzioni e dagli archetipi di costruzione all'inferenza su larga scala delle scorte edilizie. Il progetto è integrato in un progetto EU-Horizon in collaborazione con partner industriali e di ricerca esteri.

Il candidato può anche contribuire ad altre attività di ricerca e di insegnamento, nonché alla supervisione di studenti di architettura a livello di bachelor e master.

Informazioni su di noi

Il Laboratorio di Xploration strutturale è un gruppo di ricercatori dottorali e post-dottoriali nell'architettura e nell'ingegneria civile. È noto per il suo sviluppo di strumenti, metodi di progettazione, analisi su larga scala e prototipi costruiti volti a consentire al settore Architettura, Ingegneria e Costruzione (AEC) di adottare sistemi di carico più circolari. SXL contribuisce anche all'insegnamento delle tecnologie costruttive e delle pratiche circolari ai laureati, agli studenti e ai professionisti del master in architettura e ingegneria civile. Come unità della facoltà ENAC di EPFL e situata nello Smart Living Lab di Fribourg (CH), SXL beneficia dell'infrastruttura di ricerca all'avanguardia e offre un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, internazionale e stimolante.

Applicazione

Vengono considerate solo le domande presentate tramite la piattaforma online. Ti viene chiesto di fornire il tuo CV e una breve dichiarazione di interessi.

Per ulteriori informazioni, contattare teresa.messina@epfl.ch .

descriptionByLocale.de:
Profil

Das Struktur-Xploration Lab sucht einen neuen Forschungskollaborator mit einem PhD in der Gebäudetechnik, vorzugsweise im Bereich der Baustoffe und/oder der Gebäudehülle Performance und/oder Gebäudesanierung. Der Kandidat muss mit modernen Konstruktionstechniken vertraut sein und ein Interesse an den Bautechniken des 20. Jahrhunderts oder an der Architektur haben. Erfahrung in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Building Information Modelling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS) oder Computerprogrammierung ist ein Plus. Ein Master-Abschluss oder professionelle Erfahrung in der Architektur ist bevorzugt, aber nicht erforderlich.

Die Beschäftigungsquote variiert je nach Verfügbarkeit des Kandidaten zwischen 80% und 100%. Dies ist ein 9-Monats-Vertrag, erneuerbar. Das früheste Startdatum ist der 1. Mai oder so bald wie möglich.

Missionen

Die Hauptforschungsaktivitäten werden mit der Charakterisierung und zirkulären Leistungsbewertung von Gebäudeumschlägen in Europa zusammenhängen, mit einem Umfang von Baudetails und Baubogentypen bis hin zu großflächiger Beständen. Das Projekt ist in Zusammenarbeit mit ausländischen Industrie- und Forschungspartnern in ein EU-Horizon-Projekt eingebettet.

Der Kandidat kann auch zu anderen Forschungs- und Lehrtätigkeiten sowie zur Betreuung von Architekturstudenten auf Bachelor- und Masterebene beitragen.

Über uns

Das strukturelle Xploration Lab ist eine Gruppe von Doktoranden und Postdoktoranden in Architektur und Bauingenieurwesen. Es ist bekannt für die Entwicklung von Werkzeugen, Designmethoden, Großanalysen und Prototypen, die den Bereich Architektur, Ingenieurwesen und Bau (AEC) ermöglichen sollen, kreisförmige Tragsysteme zu übernehmen. SXL trägt auch zum Lehren von Gebäudetechnologien und zirkularen Praktiken zu Bachelor-, Master-Studierenden und Profis in Architektur und Bauingenieurwesen bei. Als Einheit der ENAC-Fakultät der EPFL im Smart Living Lab in Fribourg (CH) profitiert SXL von modernster Forschungsinfrastruktur und bietet ein integratives, internationales und anregendes Arbeitsumfeld.

Anwendung

Es werden nur Anträge berücksichtigt, die über die Online-Plattform eingereicht werden. Sie werden gebeten, Ihren Lebenslauf und eine kurze Interessenerklärung zu liefern.

Für weitere Informationen kontaktieren Sie bitte teresa.messina@epfl.ch .
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Profil

Le structural Xploration Lab cherche un nouveau collaborateur de recherche avec un doctorat en technologie du bâtiment, de préférence dans le domaine des matériaux de construction et/ou de la performance de l'enveloppe du bâtiment et/ou de la rénovation du bâtiment. Le candidat doit connaître les techniques de construction contemporaines et s'intéresser aux techniques de construction du XXe siècle ou à l'architecture vernaculaire. Expérience de l'évaluation du cycle de vie, de la modélisation de l'information sur les bâtiments, des systèmes d'information géographique ou de la programmation informatique est un atout. Une maîtrise ou une expérience professionnelle en architecture est préférée mais non requise.

Le taux d'emploi varie entre 80 % et 100 %, selon la disponibilité du candidat. C'est un contrat de 9 mois, renouvelable. La date de début est le 1er mai ou le plus tôt possible.

Missions

Les principales activités de recherche seront liées à la caractérisation et à l'évaluation circulaire des enveloppes de construction en Europe, avec une portée allant des détails de construction et des archétypes de construction à l'inférence à grande échelle des stocks de construction. Le projet est intégré dans un projet UE-Horizon en collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et de recherche étrangers.

Le candidat peut également contribuer à d'autres activités de recherche et d'enseignement ainsi qu'à la supervision des étudiants en architecture au niveau du baccalauréat et de la maîtrise.

Sur nous

Le Laboratoire de Xpluration structurale est un groupe de chercheurs doctorals et postdoctoraux en architecture et en génie civil. Il est connu pour son développement d'outils, de méthodes de conception, d'analyses à grande échelle et de prototypes construits visant à permettre au secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction (AEC) d'adopter des systèmes de charge plus circulaires. SXL contribue également à l'enseignement des technologies de construction et des pratiques circulaires aux étudiants de premier cycle, aux étudiants de maîtrise et aux professionnels en architecture et en génie civil. En tant qu'unité de la faculté ENAC de l'EPFL et située dans le Smart Living Lab de Fribourg (CH), SXL bénéficie d'une infrastructure de recherche de pointe et offre un environnement de travail inclusif, international et stimulant.

Demande

Seules les demandes soumises par le biais de la plateforme en ligne sont prises en considération. On vous demande de fournir votre CV et une brève déclaration d'intérêt.

Pour toute information complémentaire, veuillez contacter teresa.messina@epfl.ch .

jobs.title: Adjoint·e EM-PP / Responsable de l'assurance qualité (80-100%)

titleByLocale.en: Deputy EM-PP / Head of Quality Assurance (80-100%)
titleByLocale.fr: Adjoint·e EM-PP / Responsable de l'assurance qualité (80-100%)

jobs.description:
Mission

En tant qu’Adjoint.e EM-PP / Responsable de l’assurance qualité, vous pilotez le système qualité de l’EPFL et assurez la préparation ainsi que le suivi de l’accréditation institutionnelle. À ce titre, vous conseillez la Direction dans la définition, la mise en œuvre et le suivi de sa politique d’assurance qualité. Vous soutenez les équipes de la Présidence pour le contrôle qualité et la rédaction de divers documents stratégiques et thématiques. Par votre approche transversale et votre capacité d’influence, vous assurez un lien étroit entre stratégie, exigences d’accréditation et mise en œuvre opérationnelle, contribuant ainsi à renforcer la culture qualité de l’institution.

Principales tâches et responsabilités

• Assurer le pilotage du système d’assurance qualité de l’EPFL et coordonner les démarches liées à l’accréditation institutionnelle

• Mener la Commission Qualité pour le compte de la Direction et coordonner ses travaux, ainsi que les plans d’actions qualité et leur déploiement en collaboration et en soutien aux différentes instances de gouvernance et la communauté EPFL

• Promouvoir une culture qualité au sein de l’institution, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes, et entretenir des liens avec les homologues d’autres institutions académiques en Suisse et à l’international

• Collaboration étroite avec le service de la gestion des risques et compliance

• Rédiger et assurer le contrôle qualité de documents de la Direction, en particulier en lien avec les dossiers de la Vice-présidence en charge de l’éducation et de la recherche ainsi que les dossiers de la Présidence

• Contribuer à la rédaction de textes réglementaires, en lien avec les dossiers de la Direction et veiller à leur bonne application en collaboration avec les Affaires juridiques

• Mener, coordonner ou contribuer à des projets de gouvernance en lien avec l’état-major de la Présidence

Profil

• MSc ou PhD

• Gestion de projets avec orientation amélioration continue

• Bonne connaissance des standards d’accréditation suisses

• 5 ans minimum d’expérience professionnelle dans l’évaluation ou la révision des curricula bachelor / master ou fonction d’auditeur interne dans une université ou participation aux travaux d’une agence d’évaluation ou d’accréditation de l’enseignement supérieur ou expérience équivalente en gestion de la qualité, audit ou amélioration continue dans un environnement académique ou complexe.

• Aptitude pour le travail en équipe avec un excellent sens de l’organisation

• Indépendance dans la réalisation des tâches

• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, l'allemand étant fortement souhaité

Nous offrons

• Un environnement multiculturel d'excellence, dynamique et de renommée mondiale

• Des conditions de travail attractives

• Des possibilités de formation continue

Informations

Date d'entrée en fonction : 01.01.2027 ou date à convenir pour commencer avant

Taux d'occupation min : 80%

Taux d'occupation max : 100%

Type de contrat : CDI

Durée : Déterminée

descriptionByLocale.en:
Mission As Deputy EM-PP / Head of Quality Assurance, you are piloting the EPFL quality system and ensuring the preparation and follow-up of institutional accreditation. As such, you advise the Directorate in defining, implementing and monitoring its quality assurance policy. You support the Presidency teams in the quality control and drafting of various strategic and thematic documents. Through your cross-cutting approach and influence, you ensure a close link between strategy, accreditation requirements and operational implementation, thus contributing to strengthening the institution's quality culture. Main tasks and responsibilities
• Manage EPFL's quality assurance system and coordinate institutional accreditation processes
• Conduct the Quality Commission on behalf of the Directorate and coordinate its work, as well as the quality action plans and their deployment in collaboration and in support of the various governance bodies and the EPFL community
• Promote a quality culture within the institution, in close collaboration with internal stakeholders, and maintain links with counterparts of other academic institutions in Switzerland and internationally
• Close collaboration with the risk management department and compliance
• Prepare and ensure quality control of the Directorate's documents, in particular in relation to the files of the Vice-President in charge of education and research and the files of the Presidency
• Contribute to the drafting of regulations related to the Directorate's files and ensure their effective implementation in collaboration with Legal Affairs
• Lead, coordinate or contribute to governance projects related to the Presidency Staff Profile
• MSc or PhD
• Project management with continuous improvement
• Good knowledge of Swiss accreditation standards
• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in the evaluation or revision of bachelor's/master's degree or internal auditorship at a university or participation in the work of a higher education assessment or accreditation agency or equivalent experience in quality management, audit or continuous improvement in an academic or complex environment.
• Ability for teamwork with an excellent sense of organization
• Independence in carrying out tasks
• Mastery of French and English, German being strongly desired We offer
• A multicultural environment of excellence, dynamic and world-renowned
• Attractive working conditions
• Opportunities for continuing training Information Start date: 01.01.2027 or date to start before Min occupancy rate: 80% Max occupancy rate: 100% Type of contract: CDI Duration: Determined

jobs.description:
Main duties and responsibilities

Context – General aim of the position:

Within EPFL Sustainability, part of the Vice-Presidency for Research and Strategic Initiatives, your role will be to work with laboratories, centers and platforms to assess and reduce their environmental footprint without compromising the quality of researches.

You will liaise with various EPFL Vice-Presidencies and Faculties, and will be required to:

Green Labs Strategy

• On behalf of the head department, support, monitor and ensure the planning and implementation of the Green Labs part for the Climate and Sustainability Strategy

• Support laboratories, centers and platforms in reducing their environmental impact

• Participate in defining targets by laboratory type

• Define and propose a funding plan to support laboratories and platforms in rolling out reduction measures

• Participate in national and international working groups

Mission

Support for laboratoires

• Carrying out carbon assessments of research activities for laboratories, centers and platforms

• Analysing energy and resource consumption

• Raise awareness among research teams

• Implementing certifications such as LEAF, Sparhub or My Green Lab

• Advising on best practices, particularly regarding energy, procurement, travel, waste (including plastic), etc.

• Develop roadmaps and actions planes

Communication & engagement

• Support communication relating to the roll-out of EPFL’s research activity quantification tool, the CO2Calculator

• Participate in and/or organize, on behalf of the head department, Green Labs team coordination meetings

• Organise workshops and events

• Create educational materials

• Maintain and develop the website

• Promote the laboratories’ initiatives

• Develop a culture of sustainable research

Profile

Required experience

• Master’s or PhD level university education, or a degree from a University of Applied Sciences (HES) in engineering, environmental sciences, data analysis, digital sciences or equivalent

• 5 years’ minimum experience in methods for monitoring and accounting for GHG emissions

• 5 years’ minimum experience in managing cross-functional projects

Required skills

• Proficiency in the principles of carbon emissions accounting (e.g. GHG Protocol)

• Knowledge of methods, tools and standards for quantifying environmental footprints, such as life cycle assessment

• Strong interest in sustainability and reducing the environmental footprint

• Experience with ACV software such as SimaPro is an advantage

• Proven knowledge of the academic world

• Language skills: French and English essential

• Analytical and summarising skills, strong writing ability

• Ability to work across departments

• Demonstrate independence, proactivity and the ability to generate ideas

• Ethics and scientific integrity

We offer

• The opportunity to contribute to impactful projects aimed at reducing environmental impacts in academic research

• A flexible working environment within a dynamic, multidisciplinary team

Activity Rate Min : 80%

Activity Rate Max : 100%

Contract Type: CDD

Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten

Kontext – Allgemeines Ziel der Position:

Im Rahmen der EPFL Sustainability, einem Teil der Vice-Presidency for Research and Strategic Initiatives, wird Ihre Rolle darin bestehen, mit Laboren, Zentren und Plattformen zu arbeiten, um ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck zu bewerten und zu reduzieren, ohne die Qualität der Forschungen zu beeinträchtigen.

Sie werden mit verschiedenen EPFL-Vizepräsidenten und Fakultäten sprechen und müssen:

Grüne Labs Strategie

• Unterstützung, Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Planung und Umsetzung der Green Labs für die Klima- und Nachhaltigkeitsstrategie

• Unterstützung von Laboren, Zentren und Plattformen bei der Verringerung ihrer Umweltauswirkungen

• Maßnahmen zur Festlegung von Zielen nach Labortyp

• einen Förderplan zur Unterstützung von Laboratorien und Plattformen bei der Durchführung von Reduktionsmaßnahmen definieren und vorschlagen

• Teilnahme an nationalen und internationalen Arbeitsgruppen

Mission

Unterstützung für Workatoires

• CO2-Bewertungen von Forschungsaktivitäten für Labore, Zentren und Plattformen

• Energie- und Ressourcenverbrauch analysieren

• Sensibilisierung für Forschungsteams

• Durchführung von Zertifizierungen wie LEAF, Sparhub oder My Green Lab

• Beratung über bewährte Praktiken, insbesondere in Bezug auf Energie, Beschaffung, Reisen, Abfälle (einschließlich Kunststoff), etc.

• Entwicklung von Fahrplänen und Handlungsebenen

Kommunikation und Engagement

• Unterstützung der Kommunikation im Zusammenhang mit dem Ausrollen des Forschungsaktivitäts-Quantifizierungstools der EPFL, dem CO2Calculator

• Nehmen Sie an und/oder organisieren Sie im Auftrag der Leiterabteilung die Koordinierungssitzungen der Green Labs-Teams

• Organisieren von Workshops und Veranstaltungen

• Unterrichtsmaterialien erstellen

• Website pflegen und entwickeln

• Förderung der Initiativen der Laboratorien

• Entwicklung einer Kultur der nachhaltigen Forschung

Profil

Erforderliche Erfahrung

• Master- oder Doktorgrad-Universitätsausbildung, oder ein Studium an einer Hochschule für Angewandte Wissenschaften (HES) in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften, Datenanalyse, Digitalwissenschaften oder gleichwertig

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Methoden zur Überwachung und Abrechnung von Treibhausgasemissionen

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von funktionsübergreifenden Projekten

Erforderliche Fähigkeiten

• Effizienz in den Grundsätzen der CO2-Emissionenrechnung (z.B. GHG-Protokoll)

• Kenntnisse von Methoden, Werkzeugen und Standards zur Quantifizierung von ökologischen Fußabdrücken, wie z.B. der Lebenszyklusbewertung

• Starkes Interesse an Nachhaltigkeit und Reduzierung der Umweltbilanz

• Erfahrung mit ACV-Software wie SimaPro ist ein Vorteil

• Kenntnisse der akademischen Welt

• Sprachkenntnisse: Französisch und Englisch wesentlich

• Analytische und umfassende Fähigkeiten, starke Schreibfähigkeit

• Fähigkeit, über Abteilungen zu arbeiten

• Unabhängigkeit, Proaktivität und die Fähigkeit, Ideen zu erzeugen

• Ethik und wissenschaftliche Integrität

Wir bieten

• Die Möglichkeit, zu effektvollen Projekten beizutragen, die die Umweltauswirkungen in der akademischen Forschung verringern sollen

• Eine flexible Arbeitsumgebung innerhalb eines dynamischen, multidisziplinären Teams

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Principales fonctions et responsabilités

Contexte – Objectif général de la position :

Au sein de l'EPFL Sustainability, qui fait partie de la vice-présidence pour la recherche et les initiatives stratégiques, votre rôle sera de travailler avec les laboratoires, les centres et les plateformes pour évaluer et réduire leur empreinte environnementale sans compromettre la qualité des recherches.

Vous serez en contact avec diverses vice-présidences et facultés de l'EPFL et vous devrez :

Stratégie Green Labs

• Au nom du département principal, soutenir, suivre et assurer la planification et la mise en œuvre de la partie des laboratoires verts pour la stratégie climat et durabilité

• Aider les laboratoires, centres et plateformes à réduire leur impact sur l'environnement

• Participer à la définition des objectifs par type de laboratoire

• Définir et proposer un plan de financement pour soutenir les laboratoires et les plates-formes dans le déploiement des mesures de réduction

• Participer aux groupes de travail nationaux et internationaux

Mission

Soutien aux laboratoires

• Réalisation d'évaluations carbone des activités de recherche pour les laboratoires, les centres et les plateformes

• Analyse de la consommation d'énergie et de ressources

• Sensibiliser les équipes de recherche

• Mise en œuvre de certifications telles que LEAF, Sparhub ou My Green Lab

• Conseils sur les meilleures pratiques, notamment en matière d'énergie, d'approvisionnement, de voyage, de déchets (y compris plastiques), etc.

• Élaborer des feuilles de route et des plans d'action

Communication et engagement

• Soutenir la communication relative au déploiement de l'outil de quantification des activités de recherche de l'EPFL, le CO2Calculateur

• Participer et/ou organiser, au nom du département responsable, des réunions de coordination de l'équipe Green Labs

• Organiser des ateliers et des événements

• Créer du matériel pédagogique

• Tenir à jour et développer le site Web

• Promouvoir les initiatives des laboratoires

• Développer une culture de la recherche durable

Profil

Expérience requise

• Maîtrise ou doctorat universitaire ou diplôme d'une université des sciences appliquées (HES) en génie, sciences de l'environnement, analyse de données, sciences numériques ou équivalent

• 5 ans d'expérience minimale dans les méthodes de surveillance et de comptabilisation des émissions de GES

• 5 ans d'expérience minimale dans la gestion de projets transfonctionnels

Compétences requises

• Compétence dans les principes de la comptabilisation des émissions de carbone (par exemple Protocole sur les GES)

• Connaissance des méthodes, outils et normes de quantification des empreintes environnementales, comme l'évaluation du cycle de vie

• Un vif intérêt pour la durabilité et la réduction de l'empreinte environnementale

• L'expérience avec les logiciels ACV tels que SimaPro est un avantage

• Connaissance éprouvée du monde académique

• Compétences linguistiques : français et anglais essentiels

• Compétences d'analyse et de synthèse, forte capacité d'écriture

• Capacité de travailler dans tous les départements

• Démontrer l'indépendance, la proactivité et la capacité de générer des idées

• Éthique et intégrité scientifique

Nous offrons

• L'opportunité de contribuer à des projets d'impact visant à réduire les impacts environnementaux dans la recherche universitaire

• Un environnement de travail flexible au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multidisciplinaire

Informations

Date de début du contrat : Dès que possible

Taux d'activité Min : 80%

Taux d'activité Max : 100%

Type de contrat: CDD

Durée: 1 an

jobs.description:
Mission

We are offering a full-time (100%) PhD Student at the Laboratory for the Chemistry of Materials and Manufacturing (ALCHEMY) at EPFL Neuchatel. At EPFL ALCHEMY, we are focused on developing accessible chemistries and processing strategies that can enable the fabrication of a wide variety of advanced functional materials and devices. You will be working on a project whose goal is to develop new photocrosslinking chemistries for vat photopolymerization 3D printing technology.

Main duties and responsibilities

As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:

• Have full responsibility for your own dissertation

• Experiment design and execution

• Analyze and interpret experimental results

• Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals

• Present at international conferences

• Participate in education and supervise student projects

More specifically, within this project, you will:

• Develop non-acrylate, non-thiol-ene photocrosslinking strategies

• Develop recyclable resins for vat photopolymerization printing

• Explore high-viscosity printing with volumetric printing

Profile

• A MSc degree in the fields of materials science, chemistry, or polymer science.

• Experience with polymer characterization is required

• Excellent comunication skills in English

• Experience with small-molecule and/or polymer synthesis would be a bonus

• Experience with vat photopolymerization (broadly defined) would be a bonus

We offer

• 4 years to complete your PhD with a competitive remuneration

• You will be part of the EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH doctoral program

• An opportunity to develop a scientific career in materials science and additive manufacturing

• A world-class research and training environment with access to state-of-the-art research facilities
• A multi-cultural and stimulating work environment

• A 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years

Informations

The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. EDMX, EDAM, or EDCH.
Please check this page for additional information on admission.

Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL.

Your application should contain:

• A brief state of your past research experience and future goals (max 2 pages)

• Your detailed CV

• Contact information

• The names and contact information of 2 references willing to write a recommendation letter

Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered.

Application deadline: [01/07/2026]

Contract Start Date: As soon as possible

Activity Rate : 100.00

Contract Type: PhD Student

Duration: 1 year, renewable for 4 years

Reference: 2251

For more questions, please contact: daryl.yee@epfl.ch

jobs.description:
Introduction

The Apertus project, a joint effort between EPFL and ETH Zürich, is seeking a practical and motivated engineer to help build the next generation of open foundation models. The successful candidate will help develop and run post-training and reinforcement learning pipelines for the Apertus project.

Apertus is trained and developed on Alps, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre’s supercomputing infrastructure. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in an HPC environment and collaborating with researchers and infrastructure engineers.

Main duties and responsibilities

The engineer will contribute to the development, execution, and evaluation of scalable post-training workflows for Apertus.

Infrastructure and systems engineering

• Build and maintain containerized environments for LLM post-training and RL workloads.

• Adapt containers and dependencies for execution on Alps / CSCS infrastructure.

• Run and monitor Slurm-based training and evaluation jobs.

• Debug failures related to distributed execution, checkpointing, filesystem performance, networking, and GPU utilization.

• Help maintain reproducible training recipes, configuration files, launch scripts, and documentation.

• Work with researchers and CSCS engineers to improve the reliability and performance of large-scale experiments.

LLM post-training and Reinforcement Learning

• Support SFT, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning workflows.

• Build and run RL environments for tasks with verifiable outcomes, such as mathematics, code, tool-use, and reasoning.

• Develop reward modeling, reward calibration and verifier-based training.

• Generate and validate synthetic or gym training tasks.

• Run ablation studies comparing algorithms, reward functions, data mixtures, hyperparameters, and infrastructure settings.

• Evaluate model behavior across reasoning, coding, mathematics, instruction-following, multilingual, tool-use, and safety benchmarks.

• Debug common post-training issues, including optimization instability, reward hacking, regressions, and evaluation failures.

Profile

Essential

• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field. Exceptional BSc candidates with strong engineering experience will also be considered.

• Experience in AI and neural network architectures

• Strong collaboration and communication skills and ability to work across research and engineering teams.

Strongly preferred

• Experience with Slurm or another HPC workload manager.

• Experience building or adapting containers for HPC or GPU clusters.

• Experience with LLM fine-tuning, post-training, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning.

• Familiarity with distributed training concepts such as data parallelism, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, checkpointing, and GPU communication.

• Experience with frameworks such as veRL, slime, Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, TRL, vLLM, SGLang, or similar tools.

Nice to have

• Experience with RL for LLMs, online policy optimization, reward modeling, or RLVR.

• Experience creating verifiable tasks for mathematics, code, reasoning, or tool use.

• Familiarity with lower-level GPU/distributed libraries such as NCCL, Transformer Engine, FlashAttention, or communication backends.

• Experience with large-scale evaluation pipelines.

We offer

• A stimulating academic environment at one of the world's leading technical universities

• The opportunity to work with state-of-the-art supercomputing infrastructure and cutting-edge AI research

• Collaboration with top researchers and engineers from EPFL, ETH Zürich, CSCS, and other Swiss institutions

• Flexible working arrangements, including options for remote work

• Professional development opportunities, including conference attendance and specialized training

• The chance to contribute to open-source projects with global impact

• Access to the broader Swiss academic ecosystem

jobs.description:
IMOS

The Intelligent Maintenance and Operations Systems (IMOS) Lab at EPFL is looking for a motivated and out-of-the-box thinking PhD researcher, (100%, in Lausanne, fixed-term) starting in September or upon agreement.

Project description

The objective of this project is to develop novel methodologies based on physics-informed graph neural networks (PI-GNNs) to understand and model the impact of operational loads on system degradation at the compenent level in complex engineering systems, with a particular focus on wind turbines.

The research will focus on explicitly integrating physical laws, load dynamics, and degradation mechanisms into graph-based models, enabling a principled understanding of how operating conditions drive the evolution of system health over time. Particular emphasis will be placed on spatiotemporal modeling of interacting subsystems, where degradation emerges from coupled physical processes across components.

The project will explore how graph-based representations can capture:
• the propagation of loads and stresses across interconnected components,
• the accumulation of fatigue and damage under variable loading conditions, and
• the interaction between structural dynamics and degradation processes.

A central aspect of the research is the incorporation of physics-based inductive biases into learning architectures. This will enable the development of models that are physically consistent, interpretable, and robust under varying operating conditions, going beyond purely data-driven approaches.

Applications will include complex industrial and energy systems, with a particular focus on wind turbines, where load conditions directly influence the degradation of critical components such as blades, gearboxes, and bearings. The developed methods will contribute to improving lifetime modeling, reliability assessment, and physics-informed predictive maintenance.

This PhD position is part of an ERC Consolidator Grant, supporting cutting-edge research on physics-informed AI, intelligent maintenance, and the modeling of degradation processes in complex systems.

Profile

We are looking for a PhD candidate with a strong analytical background and an outstanding MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Engineering Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field.

You should have a solid foundation in machine learning (e.g., deep learning) and mathematical modeling, including experience with dynamical systems or differential equations. A strong interest in modeling physical systems and degradation processes (e.g., fatigue, damage accumulation) is expected.

Experience with graph neural networks or spatiotemporal models is highly desirable, as well as familiarity with physics-informed approaches that incorporate physical inductive bias into learning models.

Knowledge of one or more of the following areas is considered a strong asset:

• Physics-informed machine learning and hybrid modeling approaches

• Computational mechanics, structural dynamics, or fatigue and damage modeling

• Signal processing and analysis of measurement data from physical systems

• Scientific machine learning or numerical methods for physical systems

Strong programming skills and the ability to work at the interface of machine learning and physics-based modeling of engineering systems are expected.

We expect the candidate to be self-driven, with strong problem-solving abilities and out-of-the-box thinking. Professional command of English (both written and spoken) is mandatory.

Work Environment

EPFL is one of the most dynamic university campuses in Europe, ranks among the top 20 universities worldwide and offers an exceptional working environment with very competitive salaries.

IMOS L'Intelligent Maintenance and Operations Systems (IMOS) Lab di EPFL è alla ricerca di un ricercatore di PhD motivato e fuori dal campo, (100%, a Losanna, a tempo determinato) a partire da settembre o su accordo. Descrizione del progetto L'obiettivo di questo progetto è quello di sviluppare nuove metodologie basate sulle reti neurali a grafi in forma fisica (PI-GNN) per comprendere e modellare l'impatto dei carichi operativi sul degrado del sistema a livello convincente nei complessi sistemi di ingegneria, con particolare attenzione alle turbine eoliche. La ricerca si concentrerà sull'integrazione esplicita delle leggi fisiche, delle dinamiche di carico e dei meccanismi di degradazione nei modelli basati sui grafici, consentendo una comprensione di principio di come le condizioni operative spingono l'evoluzione della salute del sistema nel tempo. Particolare enfasi sarà posta sulla modellazione spatiotemporale dei sottosistemi interagenti, dove il degrado emerge da processi fisici accoppiati tra i componenti. Il progetto esplorerà come le rappresentazioni basate sui grafici possono catturare:
• la propagazione di carichi e sollecitazioni attraverso componenti interconnessi,
• l'accumulo di fatica e danni in condizioni di carico variabili, e
• l'interazione tra dinamiche strutturali e processi di degrado. Un aspetto centrale della ricerca è l'incorporazione dei pregiudizi induttivi basati sulla fisica nelle architetture di apprendimento. Ciò consentirà lo sviluppo di modelli fisicamente coerenti, interpretabili e robusti in diverse condizioni operative, superando approcci puramente basati sui dati. Le applicazioni includono complessi sistemi industriali ed energetici, con particolare attenzione alle turbine eoliche, dove le condizioni di carico influenzano direttamente il degrado di componenti critici come lame, riduttori e cuscinetti. I metodi sviluppati contribuiranno a migliorare la modellazione a vita, la valutazione dell'affidabilità e la manutenzione predittiva informata dalla fisica. Questa posizione PhD fa parte di un ERC Consolidator Grant, supportando la ricerca all'avanguardia sull'intelligenza artificiale, la manutenzione intelligente e la modellazione dei processi di degradazione in sistemi complessi. Profilo Siamo alla ricerca di un candidato di dottorato con un forte background analitico e un eccezionale laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Meccanica computazionale, Scienza dell'ingegneria, Fisica, Matematica applicata, o un campo strettamente correlato. Si dovrebbe avere una solida base nel machine learning (ad esempio, deep learning) e nella modellazione matematica, tra cui l'esperienza con sistemi dinamici o equazioni differenziali. Si prevede un forte interesse nella modellazione di sistemi fisici e processi di degrado (ad esempio, stanchezza, accumulo di danni). L'esperienza con reti neurali grafiche o modelli spatiotemporali è altamente auspicabile, così come la familiarità con approcci informati della fisica che incorporano pregiudizi induttivi fisici nei modelli di apprendimento. La conoscenza di una o più delle seguenti aree è considerata un bene forte:
• Approfondimenti per l'apprendimento automatico e la modellazione ibrida
• Meccanica computazionale, dinamica strutturale o modellazione di stanchezza e danni
• Elaborazione dei segnali e analisi dei dati di misura dai sistemi fisici
• Apprendimento scientifico o metodi numerici per sistemi fisici Sono previste forti competenze di programmazione e la capacità di lavorare all'interfaccia di machine learning e modellazione fisica dei sistemi di ingegneria. Ci aspettiamo che il candidato sia auto-guidato, con forti capacità di problem solving e pensiero out-of-the-box. Il comando professionale dell'inglese (sia scritto che parlato) è obbligatorio. Ambiente di lavoro EPFL è uno dei campus universitari più dinamici d'Europa, si trova tra le prime 20 università in tutto il mondo e offre un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale con stipendi molto competitivi. Il Laboratorio IMOS (https://www.epfl.ch/labs/imos/ ) offre un ambiente scientifico altamente motivante e interdisciplinare con molte opportunità di interagire tra progetti e ricercatori, e mantiene un eccellente netw
